title: Chapter 1: Greetings & Introductions
subtitle: Survival Mandarin
entry_description: Master the basics of saying hello and introducing yourself.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 你好！
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo!
dialogue.en: Hello!

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.zh: 你好！你叫什麼名字？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ jiào shénme míngzì?
dialogue.en: Hello! What is your name?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 我叫Anna，你呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Anna, nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: My name is Anna, and you?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.zh: 我是Ben。很高興認識你。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ shì Ben. Hěn gāoxìng rènshì nǐ.
dialogue.en: I am Ben. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 我也很高興認識你。你是這裡的學生嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng rènshì nǐ. Nǐ shì zhèlǐ de xuéshēng ma?
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you too. Are you a student here?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.zh: 對，我是中文系的學生。你呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, wǒ shì Zhōngwén xì de xuéshēng. Nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: Yes, I am a student in the Chinese department. And you?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 我來這裡工作，現在也在學中文。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ lái zhèlǐ gōngzuò, xiànzài yě zài xué Zhōngwén.
dialogue.en: I came here to work, and now I am also learning Chinese.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.zh: 你的中文說得很不錯！
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ de Zhōngwén shuō de hěn bùcuò!
dialogue.en: You speak Chinese very well!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！我還在努力學習。以後請多多指教。
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè! Wǒ hái zài nǔlì xuéxí. Yǐhòu qǐng duōduō zhǐjiào.
dialogue.en: Thank you! I am still studying hard. Please give me your guidance in the future.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，如果有問題可以隨時問我。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, rúguǒ yǒu wèntí kěyǐ suíshí wèn wǒ.
dialogue.en: No problem, if you have questions you can ask me anytime.

listening.text: 大家好，我叫林大明。我是美國人，今年二十五歲。我現在在台灣學中文。我的愛好是打籃球和看書。很高興認識你們，希望能和大家成為好朋友。

questions.q: What is the speaker's name?
Where is the speaker from?
How old is the speaker?
What are the speaker's hobbies?
What does the speaker hope for?
options: To become good friends with everyone
questions.answer: To become good friends with everyone

reading.text: 王小明和李大華是新同學。王小明是台灣人，李大華是日本人。他們今天在學校圖書館見面。王小明幫李大華找了幾本中文書。李大華覺得王小明很友善，他們很快就變成了好朋友。

questions.q: Who are the new classmates?
Where is Li Dahua from?
Where did they meet today?
What did Wang Xiaoming help Li Dahua with?
How does Li Dahua feel about Wang Xiaoming?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 你是哪國人？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
dialogue.en: Which country are you from?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 我是英國人。老師呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ shì Yīngguó rén. Lǎoshī ne?
dialogue.en: I am British. And you, teacher?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 我是台灣人，出生在台北。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ shì Táiwān rén, chūshēng zài Táiběi.
dialogue.en: I am Taiwanese, born in Taipei.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 台北很熱鬧。你來英國過嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Táiběi hěn rènào. Nǐ lái Yīngguó guò ma?
dialogue.en: Taipei is very bustling. Have you ever been to the UK?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 去過一次，那裡的冬天很冷，可是風景很美。
dialogue.pinyin: Qù guò yī cì, nàlǐ de dōngtiān hěn lěng, kěshì fēngjǐng hěn měi.
dialogue.en: I've been there once, the winter there is very cold, but the scenery is beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。我比較喜歡台灣的天氣，冬天不那麼冷。
dialogue.pinyin: Méicuò. Wǒ bǐjiào xǐhuān Táiwān de tiānqì, dōngtiān bù nàme lěng.
dialogue.en: That's right. I prefer Taiwan's weather, winter is not that cold.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 那你習慣台灣的食物嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nǐ xíguàn Táiwān de shíwù ma?
dialogue.en: Are you used to Taiwanese food then?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 非常習慣！我最喜歡吃小籠包。
dialogue.pinyin: Fēicháng xíguàn! Wǒ zuì xǐhuān chī xiǎolóngbāo.
dialogue.en: Very used to it! My favorite is eating soup dumplings (xiaolongbao).

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 那太好了，下次有機會我可以帶你去吃最好吃的小籠包。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà tài hǎo le, xià cì yǒu jīhuì wǒ kěyǐ dài nǐ qù chī zuì hǎo chī de xiǎolóngbāo.
dialogue.en: That's great, next time if there's a chance I can take you to eat the most delicious soup dumplings.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 一言為定！非常感謝老師。
dialogue.pinyin: Yīyán wéidìng! Fēicháng gǎnxiè lǎoshī.
dialogue.en: It's a deal! Thank you very much, teacher.

listening.text: 他是美國人，我是台灣人。我們是好朋友。雖然我們來自不同的國家，但是我們都喜歡學習語言。他教我英文，我教他中文。週末的時候，我們常一起去喝咖啡。

questions.q: Where is 'he' from?
Where is the speaker from?
What is their common interest?
What does the speaker teach 'him'?
What do they usually do on weekends?

reading.text: 我的朋友叫John，他是英國人。他現在在台灣學中文。他覺得台灣很漂亮，人們也很熱情。John最喜歡去夜市，因為那裡有很多好吃的小吃，而且可以練習說中文。他希望明年能通過中文考試。

questions.q: Where is John from?
What is John doing in Taiwan?
What does John think of Taiwanese people?
Why does John like going to the night market?
options: To eat delicious snacks and practice Chinese
questions.answer: To eat delicious snacks and practice Chinese

questions.q: What is John's goal for next year?

title: Chapter 2: Restaurant & Ordering
subtitle: Survival Mandarin
entry_description: Learn to order food and request the bill.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 歡迎光臨，請問有幾位？
dialogue.pinyin: Huānyíng guānglín, qǐngwèn yǒu jǐ wèi?
dialogue.en: Welcome, how many people in your party?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 兩位。請問還有位子嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Liǎng wèi. Qǐngwèn hái yǒu wèizi ma?
dialogue.en: Two people. Are there any seats left?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 有的，請跟我來。這是菜單，想吃點什麼？
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu de, qǐng gēn wǒ lái. Zhè shì càidān, xiǎng chī diǎn shénme?
dialogue.en: Yes, please follow me. Here is the menu, what would you like to eat?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 我要一碗牛肉麵，要大碗的。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yào yī wǎn niúròu miàn, yào dà wǎn de.
dialogue.en: I want a bowl of beef noodles, a large bowl.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 好的，牛肉麵要不要加辣？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, niúròu miàn yào bùyào jiā là?
dialogue.en: Okay, do you want the beef noodles spicy?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 一點點辣就好。另外，再點一份燙青菜。
dialogue.pinyin: Yīdiǎndiǎn là jiù hǎo. Lìngwài, zài diǎn yī fèn tàng qīngcài.
dialogue.en: Just a little bit spicy. Also, I'll order a portion of blanched vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 燙青菜今天有空心菜和高麗菜，您要哪一種？
dialogue.pinyin: Tàng qīngcài jīntiān yǒu kōngxīncài hé gāolìcài, nín yào nǎ yī zhǒng?
dialogue.en: For blanched vegetables today we have water spinach and cabbage, which one do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 我要高麗菜。還要兩杯冰紅茶，微糖少冰。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yào gāolìcài. Hái yào liǎng bēi bīng hóngchá, wéitáng shǎo bīng.
dialogue.en: I want cabbage. And two glasses of iced black tea, light sugar and less ice.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 好的，一碗大牛肉麵小辣，一份高麗菜，兩杯微糖少冰紅茶。請問需要小菜嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, yī wǎn dà niúròu miàn xiǎo là, yī fèn gāolìcài, liǎng bēi wéitáng shǎo bīng hóngchá. Qǐngwèn xūyào xiǎocài ma?
dialogue.en: Okay, one large beef noodle soup lightly spicy, one cabbage, two glasses of light sugar less ice black tea. Do you need any side dishes?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 不用了，先這樣，謝謝。
dialogue.pinyin: Bùyòng le, xiān zhèyàng, xièxiè.
dialogue.en: No need, that's all for now, thank you.

listening.text: 老闆，我要兩個滷肉飯和一碗貢丸湯。滷肉飯請幫我多加一點醬汁。我要外帶，謝謝。請問這樣一共多少錢？

questions.q: What did the person order?
options: Braised pork rice and meatball soup
questions.answer: Braised pork rice and meatball soup

questions.q: How many bowls of braised pork rice?
What special request did the person have for the rice?
Are they eating in or taking out?
What did the person ask at the end?

reading.text: 台灣的夜市非常有名，每天晚上都很熱鬧。我最喜歡去夜市吃臭豆腐和喝珍珠奶茶。雖然臭豆腐聞起來很臭，但是吃起來外酥內軟，非常好吃。如果你有機會來台灣，一定要去夜市逛逛。

questions.q: What is famous in Taiwan and bustling every night?
What is the author's favorite food to eat there?
What drink does the author like to have?
How is the texture of the stinky tofu described?
options: Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside (外酥內軟)
questions.answer: Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside (外酥內軟)

questions.q: What does the author recommend you to do if you visit Taiwan?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 老闆，我們吃飽了，買單！
dialogue.pinyin: Lǎobǎn, wǒmen chī bǎo le, mǎidān!
dialogue.en: Boss, we are full, check please!

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.zh: 好的，請問是哪一桌？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐngwèn shì nǎ yī zhuō?
dialogue.en: Okay, which table is it?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 五號桌。麻煩你看一下。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǔ hào zhuō. Máfan nǐ kàn yīxià.
dialogue.en: Table number 5. Please take a look.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.zh: 五號桌，兩碗麵和兩杯飲料，一共是三百二十塊。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǔ hào zhuō, liǎng wǎn miàn hé liǎng bēi yǐnliào, yīgòng shì sān bǎi èrshí kuài.
dialogue.en: Table 5, two bowls of noodles and two drinks, altogether it's 320 NTD.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 請問這裡可以用LINE Pay嗎？還是只能付現金？
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn zhèlǐ kěyǐ yòng LINE Pay ma? Háishì zhǐ néng fù xiànjīn?
dialogue.en: Can I use LINE Pay here? Or is it cash only?

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.zh: 可以用LINE Pay，也可以刷卡，都沒問題。
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ yòng LINE Pay, yě kěyǐ shuākǎ, dōu méi wèntí.
dialogue.en: You can use LINE Pay, or swipe a credit card, both are fine.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 那我要用LINE Pay。我掃你的條碼對嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà wǒ yào yòng LINE Pay. Wǒ sǎo nǐ de tiáomǎ duì ma?
dialogue.en: Then I will use LINE Pay. I scan your barcode, right?

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.zh: 對的，條碼在櫃檯這邊。嗶一下就可以了。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì de, tiáomǎ zài guìtái zhèbiān. Bī yīxià jiù kěyǐ le.
dialogue.en: Yes, the barcode is here at the counter. Just scan it.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 好了，付過去了。你需要確認一下嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo le, fù guòqù le. Nǐ xūyào quèrèn yīxià ma?
dialogue.en: Done, sent. Do you need to confirm it?

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.zh: 收到了。謝謝你們，歡迎下次再來！
dialogue.pinyin: Shōu dào le. Xièxiè nǐmen, huānyíng xià cì zài lái!
dialogue.en: Received. Thank you, welcome to come again next time!

listening.text: 您好，一共是一百五十元。收您五百元，找您三百五十元。這是您的發票，請問需要幫您把發票存入載具嗎？

questions.q: How much is the total?
How much did the customer give?
How much is the change?
What did the cashier give to the customer?
What did the cashier ask about the receipt?
options: Do you want to throw it away?
Do you want to save it to an e-invoice carrier (載具)?
Do you want a physical copy only?
questions.answer: Do you want to save it to an e-invoice carrier (載具)?

reading.text: 這家傳統餐廳非常受歡迎，但是他們不接受信用卡，也不能用電子支付，只能付現金。如果你身上沒有現金，可以去旁邊的便利商店提款機領錢。吃完飯後，記得要把碗盤拿到回收區。

questions.q: Can you use a credit card at this traditional restaurant?
How must you pay?
Where can you withdraw money if you don't have cash?
What should you do after finishing your meal?
options: Take the dishes to the recycling area (回收區)
questions.answer: Take the dishes to the recycling area (回收區)

questions.q: Is the restaurant popular?

title: Chapter 3: Shopping & Bargaining
subtitle: Survival Mandarin
entry_description: Learn numbers and how to ask for prices.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 老闆，請問這個杯子多少錢？
dialogue.pinyin: Lǎobǎn, qǐngwèn zhège bēizi duōshǎo qián?
dialogue.en: Boss, excuse me, how much is this cup?

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.zh: 那個杯子是手工做的，五百塊。
dialogue.pinyin: Nàge bēizi shì shǒugōng zuò de, wǔ bǎi kuài.
dialogue.en: That cup is handmade, 500 NTD.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 五百塊？太貴了！可以便宜一點嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǔ bǎi kuài? Tài guì le! Kěyǐ piányí yīdiǎn ma?
dialogue.en: 500? Too expensive! Can it be a bit cheaper?

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.zh: 這可是真材實料。你想多少錢買？
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè kěshì zhēncáishíliào. Nǐ xiǎng duōshǎo qián mǎi?
dialogue.en: This is made of genuine materials. How much do you want to buy it for?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 三百五十塊可以嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Sān bǎi wǔshí kuài kěyǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Is 350 okay?

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.zh: 三百五太低了，我會虧本的。算你四百五十吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Sān bǎi wǔ tài dī le, wǒ huì kuīběn de. Suàn nǐ sì bǎi wǔshí ba.
dialogue.en: 350 is too low, I will lose money. I'll give it to you for 450.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 四百塊好不好？我再多買一個盤子。
dialogue.pinyin: Sì bǎi kuài hǎobùhǎo? Wǒ zài duō mǎi yīgè pánzi.
dialogue.en: How about 400? I'll also buy a plate.

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.zh: 好吧，看你買得多，杯子算你四百，盤子兩百。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo ba, kàn nǐ mǎi de duō, bēizi suàn nǐ sì bǎi, pánzi liǎng bǎi.
dialogue.en: Alright, seeing that you're buying more, the cup is 400, the plate is 200.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 太好了，一共六百塊。給您。
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, yīgòng liù bǎi kuài. Gěi nín.
dialogue.en: Great, altogether 600 NTD. Here you go.

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我幫你包裝起來。小心拿哦。
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè, wǒ bāng nǐ bāozhuāng qǐlái. Xiǎoxīn ná ó.
dialogue.en: Thank you, I'll wrap it up for you. Hold it carefully.

listening.text: 今天我去逛街，買了兩件衣服和一條褲子。這件紅色的衣服一千元，藍色的八百元。那條褲子比較貴，要一千五百元。我今天一共花了三千三百元。

questions.q: How much is the red shirt?
How much is the blue shirt?
How much are the pants?
What is the total amount spent?
Which item was the most expensive?

reading.text: 在台灣傳統市場買東西，有時候可以跟老闆殺價。例如，蘋果一個三十元，香蕉一串五十元。如果你買了很多水果，可以問老闆：「老闆，買多一點有打折嗎？」通常老闆會送你一點東西，或是算便宜一點。

questions.q: How much is one apple?
How much is a bunch of bananas?
What can you do at a traditional market in Taiwan?
What question can you ask if you buy a lot?
options: Is there a discount for buying more? (買多一點有打折嗎？)
questions.answer: Is there a discount for buying more? (買多一點有打折嗎？)

questions.q: What might the boss do if you bargain successfully?
options: Give you free items or a cheaper price
questions.answer: Give you free items or a cheaper price

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 你好，請問我可以試穿這件外套嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn wǒ kěyǐ shìchuān zhè jiàn wàitào ma?
dialogue.en: Hello, excuse me, can I try on this jacket?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，試衣間在前面右轉那邊。
dialogue.pinyin: Dāngrán kěyǐ, shìyījiān zài qiánmiàn yòuzhuǎn nàbiān.
dialogue.en: Of course, the fitting room is ahead on the right.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: （幾分鐘後）這件穿起來有點小，肩膀有點緊。有大一點的嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: (Jǐ fēnzhōng hòu) Zhè jiàn chuān qǐlái yǒudiǎn xiǎo, jiānbǎng yǒudiǎn jǐn. Yǒu dà yīdiǎn de ma?
dialogue.en: (A few minutes later) This one feels a bit small, the shoulders are a bit tight. Do you have a bigger one?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 這件是M號的，我幫你拿L號試試看。請稍等。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì M hào de, wǒ bāng nǐ ná L hào shìshì kàn. Qǐng shāoděng.
dialogue.en: This is size M, I'll get an L for you to try. Please wait a moment.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 好的，麻煩你了。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, máfan nǐ le.
dialogue.en: Okay, thank you for your trouble.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: L號來了。你覺得這件顏色適合你嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: L hào lái le. Nǐ juédé zhè jiàn yánsè shìhé nǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Here is size L. Do you think this color suits you?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 黑色滿好看的，也很百搭。L號剛好。
dialogue.pinyin: Hēisè mǎn hǎokàn de, yě hěn bǎidā. L hào gānghǎo.
dialogue.en: Black is pretty nice, and it matches everything. Size L fits perfectly.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 太好了，現在這款外套打八折喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, xiànzài zhè kuǎn wàitào dǎ bā zhé ō.
dialogue.en: Great, this jacket is currently 20% off.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 那打折後是多少錢？

title: Chapter 4: Taking a Taxi
subtitle: Survival Mandarin
entry_description: Learn to give basic directions to a driver.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 你好，要去哪裡？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, yào qù nǎlǐ?
dialogue.en: Hello, where are you going?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 我要去台北車站。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù Táiběi Chēzhàn.
dialogue.en: I want to go to Taipei Main Station.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 你要去東門還是南門？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yào qù dōngmén háishì nánmén?
dialogue.en: Do you want to go to the East Gate or the South Gate?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 請把我放在東三門，我要去搭高鐵。
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ wǒ fàng zài dōng sān mén, wǒ yào qù dā gāotiě.
dialogue.en: Please drop me off at East Gate 3, I need to take the High Speed Rail.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 好的。現在路上有點塞車，大概需要二十分鐘。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de. Xiànzài lùshàng yǒudiǎn sāichē, dàgài xūyào èrshí fēnzhōng.
dialogue.en: Okay. There's a bit of a traffic jam on the road now, it will take about 20 minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我的車是一小時後開。我不趕時間。
dialogue.pinyin: Méiguānxì, wǒ de chē shì yī xiǎoshí hòu kāi. Wǒ bù gǎn shíjiān.
dialogue.en: No worries, my train leaves in an hour. I am not in a hurry.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 冷氣會太冷嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Lěngqì huì tài lěng ma?
dialogue.en: Is the AC too cold?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 有一點，可以稍微調弱一點嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu yīdiǎn, kěyǐ shāowéi tiáo ruò yīdiǎn ma?
dialogue.en: A little bit, can you turn it down slightly?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。請繫好安全帶。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Qǐng xì hǎo ānquándài.
dialogue.en: No problem. Please fasten your seatbelt.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 好的，謝謝。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, xièxiè.
dialogue.en: Okay, thanks.

listening.text: 司機先生，麻煩你到中山路一百號。我現在有點趕時間，因為我有一個很重要的會議，能開快一點嗎？如果走高速公路會比較快嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 司機，前面那個紅綠燈路口請右轉。
dialogue.pinyin: Sījī, qiánmiàn nàge hónglǜdēng lùkǒu qǐng yòuzhuǎn.
dialogue.en: Driver, please turn right at the traffic light intersection ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 好的。右轉之後要在哪裡下車？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de. Yòuzhuǎn zhīhòu yào zài nǎlǐ xiàchē?
dialogue.en: Okay. Where do you want to get off after turning right?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 右轉後大約走一百公尺，那裡有一家便利商店。
dialogue.pinyin: Yòuzhuǎn hòu dàyuē zǒu yī bǎi gōngchǐ, nàlǐ yǒu yī jiā biànlì shāngdiàn.
dialogue.en: Walk about 100 meters after turning right, there is a convenience store there.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 我看到了，就在便利商店門口停嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào le, jiù zài biànlì shāngdiàn ménkǒu tíng ma?
dialogue.en: I see it, stop right at the entrance of the convenience store?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 對，就在那裡停。麻煩你了。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, jiù zài nàlǐ tíng. Máfan nǐ le.
dialogue.en: Yes, stop right there. Sorry for the trouble.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 到了，請注意後方來車。一共是兩百五十元。
dialogue.pinyin: Dào le, qǐng zhùyì hòufāng lái chē. Yīgòng shì liǎng bǎi wǔshí yuán.
dialogue.en: We've arrived, please watch out for cars coming from behind. It's 250 NTD in total.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 我給您三百元，不用找了。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nín sān bǎi yuán, bùyòng zhǎo le.
dialogue.en: I'll give you 300 NTD, keep the change.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 非常感謝！您有行李在後車廂嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Fēicháng gǎnxiè! Nín yǒu xínglǐ zài hòuchēxiāng ma?
dialogue.en: Thank you very much! Do you have luggage in the trunk?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我只有這個背包。
dialogue.pinyin: Méiyǒu, wǒ zhǐyǒu zhège bēibāo.
dialogue.en: No, I only have this backpack.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 好的，再見！
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, zàijiàn!
dialogue.en: Okay, goodbye!

listening.text: 請直走，過兩個紅綠燈以後左轉。左轉後你會看到一間學校。我的家就在學校的右手邊，是一棟白色的房子。

title: Chapter 5: Convenience Store
subtitle: Daily Life
entry_description: Navigate Taiwan's omnipresent convenience stores.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 您好，一共是兩百五十元。需要購物袋嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nín hǎo, yīgòng shì liǎng bǎi wǔshí yuán. Xūyào gòuwùdài ma?
dialogue.en: Hello, it's 250 NTD in total. Do you need a shopping bag?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 不用，我自己有帶環保袋。這個便當可以幫我微波嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Bùyòng, wǒ zìjǐ yǒu dài huánbǎodài. Zhège biàndāng kěyǐ bāng wǒ wéibō ma?
dialogue.en: No, I brought my own reusable bag. Can you microwave this bento for me?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 可以，請稍等一下。微波要一分鐘。有會員嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ, qǐng shāoděng yīxià. Wéibō yào yī fēnzhōng. Yǒu huìyuán ma?
dialogue.en: Yes, please wait a moment. Microwaving takes one minute. Do you have a membership?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu, wǒ bào diànhuà hàomǎ. Lǐng-jiǔ-yī-èr-sān-sì-wǔ-liù-qī-bā.
dialogue.en: Yes, I'll give my phone number. 0912-345-678.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的，點數幫您存進去了。要列印紙本發票嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, diǎnshù bāng nín cún jìnqù le. Yào lièyìn zhǐběn fāpiào ma?
dialogue.en: Okay, the points have been saved for you. Do you want to print a physical receipt?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 發票幫我存載具，謝謝。我刷卡。
dialogue.pinyin: Fāpiào bāng wǒ cún zǎijù, xièxiè. Wǒ shuākǎ.
dialogue.en: Save the receipt to my carrier, thanks. I'll pay by card.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的，請感應卡片。便當微波好了，小心燙。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng gǎnyìng kǎpiàn. Biàndāng wéibō hǎo le, xiǎoxīn tàng.
dialogue.en: Okay, please tap your card. The bento is microwaved, careful it's hot.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，請問你們這裡有賣郵票嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè nǐ, qǐngwèn nǐmen zhèlǐ yǒu mài yóupiào ma?
dialogue.en: Thank you, do you sell stamps here?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 有的，請問要寄國內還是國外？
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu de, qǐngwèn yào jì guónèi háishì guówài?
dialogue.en: Yes, are you sending domestic or international?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 國內的，給我兩張八塊的。我付現金。
dialogue.pinyin: Guónèi de, gěi wǒ liǎng zhāng bā kuài de. Wǒ fù xiànjīn.
dialogue.en: Domestic, give me two 8 NTD ones. I'll pay cash.

reading.text: 台灣的便利商店非常強大，幾乎什麼都能做。你可以買便當、喝現煮咖啡、繳水電費、寄收包裹，甚至還可以買演唱會門票或高鐵票。而且大部分都是二十四小時營業，不管什麼時候去都很方便。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 你好，我要拿網購的包裹。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào ná wǎnggòu de bāoguǒ.
dialogue.en: Hello, I want to pick up an online shopping package.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的，請問手機號碼末三碼是多少？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐngwèn shǒujī hàomǎ mò sān mǎ shì duōshǎo?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 八五二。
dialogue.pinyin: Bā wǔ èr.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 我找一下... 林大明先生對嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo yīxià... Lín Dàmíng xiānshēng duì ma?
dialogue.en: Let me look for it... Mr. Lin Daming, right?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 對的。包裹已經在網路上付過錢了。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì de. Bāoguǒ yǐjīng zài wǎnglù shàng fù guò qián le.
dialogue.en: Yes. The package has already been paid for online.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的，因為是0元包裹，請出示一下您的身分證或健保卡確認身分。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, yīnwèi shì líng yuán bāoguǒ, qǐng chūshì yīxià nín de shēnfènzhèng huò jiànbǎokǎ quèrèn shēnfèn.
dialogue.en: Okay, since it's a 0 NTD package, please show your ID card or health insurance card to verify your identity.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 給您，這是我的居留證。
dialogue.pinyin: Gěi nín, zhè shì wǒ de jūliúzhèng.
dialogue.en: Here you go, this is my ARC.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的，確認無誤。請在螢幕上簽名。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, quèrèn wúwù. Qǐng zài yíngmù shàng qiānmíng.
dialogue.en: Okay, confirmed correct. Please sign on the screen.

dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.pinyin: Qiān hǎo le. Zhèyàng jiù kěyǐ ná zǒu le ma?
dialogue.en: Signed. Can I take it now?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 是的，這是您的包裹和收據。謝謝！
dialogue.pinyin: Shì de, zhè shì nín de bāoguǒ hé shōujù. Xièxiè!
dialogue.en: Yes, here is your package and receipt. Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 請問，去101大樓要坐哪一線？
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, qù yī-líng-yī dàlóu yào zuò nǎ yī xiàn?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, which line should I take to get to the 101 building?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 請坐紅線，往象山的方向。
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐng zuò hóngxiàn, wǎng Xiàngshān de fāngxiàng.
dialogue.en: Please take the Red Line, towards Xiangshan.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 大概要坐幾站呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Dàgài yào zuò jǐ zhàn ne?
dialogue.en: About how many stations do I need to ride?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 從這裡坐四站，在台北101站下車就可以了。
dialogue.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ zuò sì zhàn, zài Táiběi yī-líng-yī zhàn xiàchē jiù kěyǐ le.
dialogue.en: Take four stops from here and get off at the Taipei 101 station.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist

dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè. Wǒ yǒu yī zhāng yōuyóukǎ, kěyǐ zhíjiē shuākǎ jìnzhàn ma?
dialogue.en: Thank you. I have an EasyCard; can I just swipe it to enter the station?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 可以的。如果餘額不足，旁邊有加值機可以加值。
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ de. Rúguǒ yú'é bùzú, pángbiān yǒu jiāzhíjī kěyǐ jiāzhí.
dialogue.en: Yes. If the balance is insufficient, there is a top-up machine nearby.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 加值機可以用信用卡嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Jiāzhíjī kěyǐ yòng xìnyòngkǎ ma?
dialogue.en: Can the top-up machine use a credit card?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 有些可以，但大部分還是用現金。建議您先準備好現金。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒuxiē kěyǐ, dàn dà bùfèn háishì yòng xiànjīn. Jiànyì nín xiān zhǔnbèi hǎo xiànjīn.
dialogue.en: Some can, but most still use cash. I suggest you prepare cash first.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist

dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ zhīdào le. Jiéyùnzhàn lǐmiàn kěyǐ hēshuǐ ma?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 有，請上車。上車下車都要刷卡喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu, qǐng shàngchē. Shàngchē xiàchē dōu yào shuākǎ ō.
dialogue.en: Yes, please get on. You need to swipe your card both when getting on and off.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 好的，大概要坐多久？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, dàgài yào zuò duōjiǔ?
dialogue.en: Okay, about how long will it take?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 大約十五到二十分鐘。現在車上人很多，請站穩。
dialogue.pinyin: Dàyuē shíwǔ dào èrshí fēnzhōng. Xiànzài chēshàng rén hěnduō, qǐng zhànwěn.
dialogue.en: About 15 to 20 minutes. There are many people on the bus now, please stand firmly.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 我知道了。請問下車前要按鈴嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào le. Qǐngwèn xiàchē qián yào ànlíng ma?
dialogue.en: I see. Do I need to press the bell before getting off?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 對，如果要下車，請提前按鈴。我才會停靠。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, rúguǒ yào xiàchē, qǐng tíqián ànlíng. Wǒ cáihuì tíngkào.
dialogue.en: Yes, if you want to get off, please press the bell in advance. Then I will pull over.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 故宮是哪一站？司機可以提醒我嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Gùgōng shì nǎ yī zhàn? Sījī kěyǐ tíxǐng wǒ ma?
dialogue.en: Which stop is the Palace Museum? Can you remind me, driver?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，快到的時候我會喊一下。你也可以看車頭的螢幕。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, kuài dào de shíhòu wǒ huì hǎn yīxià. Nǐ yě kěyǐ kàn chētóu de yíngmù.
dialogue.en: No problem, I'll give a shout when we're close. You can also look at the screen at the front of the bus.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 太感謝了。這台車可以用現金付錢嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Tài gǎnxiè le. Zhè tái chē kěyǐ yòng xiànjīn fù qián ma?
dialogue.en: Thank you so much. Can I pay with cash on this bus?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 可以投幣，但不找零喔，所以要準備好剛好的零錢。
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ tóubì, dàn bù zhǎolíng ō, suǒyǐ yào zhǔnbèi hǎo gānghǎo de língqián.
dialogue.en: You can drop coins, but no change is given, so you have to prepare the exact amount of change.

listening.text: 下一站，中山國小。請由後門下車。下車時請注意階梯及後方來車。謝謝您的搭乘，我們下次再見。

Where should passengers exit from?
What should passengers watch out for when exiting?
options: Steps and vehicles coming from behind
questions.answer: Steps and vehicles coming from behind

What is the tone of the announcement?

reading.text: 在台灣坐公車，如果你要下車，記得一定要按鈴告知司機。如果你是在站牌等車的人，當你看到你想搭的公車來了，請務必招手示意，否則司機可能會以為沒人要上車而直接開走。另外，現在大部分的公車都是上車下車都要刷卡，以免扣錯錢。

What should you do when you see the bus coming while waiting at the stop?
What happens if you don't wave at the bus stop?
options: The bus will wait for you

options: Both when getting on and off
questions.answer: Both when getting on and off

questions.answer: To avoid incorrect fare deduction (扣錯錢)

title: Chapter 7: Post Office
subtitle: Daily Life
entry_description: Learn to send letters and packages at the post office.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想寄這個包裹到美國給我的家人。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng jì zhège bāoguǒ dào Měiguó gěi wǒ de jiārén.
dialogue.en: Hello, I want to send this package to the USA for my family.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的。請問裡面是什麼東西？有危險品或是液體嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de. Qǐngwèn lǐmiàn shì shénme dōngxī? Yǒu wēixiǎnpǐn háishì yètǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. What is inside? Are there any dangerous goods or liquids?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 裡面是一些衣服、幾本書和一點台灣的餅乾。沒有危險品。
dialogue.pinyin: Lǐmiàn shì yīxiē yīfú, jǐ běn shū hé yīdiǎn Táiwān de bǐngqián. Méiyǒu wēixiǎnpǐn.
dialogue.en: Inside are some clothes, a few books, and some Taiwanese cookies. No dangerous goods.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的，請把包裹放在秤上。一共是三點五公斤。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng bǎ bāoguǒ fàng zài chèng shàng. Yīgòng shì sān diǎn wǔ gōngjīn.
dialogue.en: Okay, please put the package on the scale. It's 3.5 kilograms in total.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 寄到美國大概需要多久？我希望在下個月以前寄到。
dialogue.pinyin: Jì dào Měiguó dàgài xūyào duōjiǔ? Wǒ xīwàng zài xià gè yuè yǐqián jì dào.
dialogue.en: How long will it take to send to the USA? I hope it arrives before next month.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 空運大約要七到十天，海運的話要一兩個月。您要哪一種？
dialogue.pinyin: Kōngyùn dàyuē yào qī dào shí tiān, hǎiyùn de huà yào yī liǎng gè yuè. Nín yào nǎ yī zhǒng?
dialogue.en: Air mail takes about 7 to 10 days, sea mail takes one to two months. Which one do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 那我選空運。運費是多少錢？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà wǒ xuǎn kōngyùn. Yùnfèi shì duōshǎo qián?
dialogue.en: Then I'll choose air mail. How much is the shipping fee?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 空運是一千兩百元。請填寫一下這張國際包裹單。
dialogue.pinyin: Kōngyùn shì yī qiān liù bǎi yuán. Qǐng tiánxiě yīxià zhè zhāng guójì bāoguǒ dān.
dialogue.en: Air mail is 1200 NTD. Please fill out this international package form.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 好的。寄件人資訊要寫中文還是英文？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de. Jìjiànrén zīxùn yào xiě Zhōngwén háishì Yīngwén?
dialogue.en: Okay. Should the sender information be written in Chinese or English?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 寄到國外的包裹，地址請務必寫英文。姓名可以寫中文。
dialogue.pinyin: Jì dào guówài de bāoguǒ, dìzhǐ qǐng wùbì xiě Yīngwén. Xìngmíng kěyǐ xiě Zhōngwén.
dialogue.en: For packages sent abroad, the address must be written in English. The name can be in Chinese.

listening.text: 我要寄這封信，用掛號寄到台中。裡面有一張很重要的證件，麻煩幫我貼上標籤。一共是二十八元。這是您的收據，請收好。

questions.q: What is the person sending?
Where is the destination?
What kind of mail service is used?
Why is it sent this way?
options: Because there's an important document inside
questions.answer: Because there's an important document inside

questions.q: How much does it cost?

reading.text: 如果你寄包裹的時候不在家，郵差通常會留下一張領取通知單。你可以帶著這張通知單和你的身分證，去指定的郵局領取。如果你的包裹非常大，也可以請郵局再幫你投遞一次，但可能需要額外付費。

questions.q: What does the mailman leave if you aren't home for a delivery?
What two things do you need to bring to the post office?
options: Notice and ID card (通知單和身分證)
questions.answer: Notice and ID card (通知單和身分證)

questions.q: Where should you go to pick up the package?
Can you ask for a second delivery attempt?
options: Yes, but it might cost extra
questions.answer: Yes, but it might cost extra

questions.q: Who delivers the mail in Taiwan?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 請問，這裡有賣郵票嗎？我想寄明信片。
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhèlǐ yǒu mài yóupiào ma? Wǒ xiǎng jì míngxìnpiàn.
dialogue.en: Excuse me, do you sell stamps here? I want to send postcards.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 有的。請問要寄到哪裡？國內還是國外？
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu de. Qǐngwèn yào jì dào nǎlǐ? Guónèi háishì guówài?
dialogue.en: Yes. Where are you sending them? Domestic or international?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 我要寄明信片到日本，一共三張。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yào jì míngxìnpiàn dào Rìběn, yīgòng sān zhāng.
dialogue.en: I want to send postcards to Japan, three of them.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 寄到日本的明信片一張是十元，三張共三十元。
dialogue.pinyin: Jì dào Rìběn de míngxìnpiàn yī zhāng shì shí yuán, sān zhāng gòng sānshí yuán.
dialogue.en: Postcards to Japan are 10 NTD each, so 30 NTD for three.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 那寄到美國呢？也是十元嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà jì dào Měiguó ne? Yěshì shí yuán ma?
dialogue.en: What about to the USA? Is it also 10 NTD?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 寄到美國比較貴，明信片一張是十二元。
dialogue.pinyin: Jì dào Měiguó bǐjiào guì, míngxìnpiàn yī zhāng shì shí'èr yuán.
dialogue.en: To the USA is more expensive, 12 NTD per postcard.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 好，那我也買三張寄到美國的郵票。謝謝。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ yě mǎi sān zhāng jì dào Měiguó de yóupiào. Xièxiè.
dialogue.en: Okay, then I'll also buy three stamps for the USA. Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。這裡一共是六十六元。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Zhèlǐ yīgòng shì liùshíliù yuán.
dialogue.en: No problem. That's 66 NTD in total.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 請問郵筒在哪裡？我寫完可以直接投進去嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn yóutǒng zài nǎlǐ? Wǒ xiě wán kěyǐ zhíjiē tóu jìnqù ma?
dialogue.en: Where is the mailbox? Can I drop them in directly after writing?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 郵局門口就有郵筒。紅色的寄國外和限時，綠色的寄國內普通信件。
dialogue.pinyin: Yóujú ménkǒu jiù yǒu yóutǒng. Hóngsè de jì guówài hé xiànshí, lǜsè de jì guónèi pǔtōng xìnjiàn.
dialogue.en: There's a mailbox right outside the post office. Red is for international and express, green is for domestic ordinary mail.

listening.text: 這封限時批信要在明天早上以前送到。裡面是急用的文件，麻煩幫我處理成最快的快遞。運費貴一點沒關係。

questions.q: What is the level of urgency for this mail?
When does it need to arrive at the latest?
What is the content of the mail?
What is the customer's attitude towards the shipping fee?
options: They want it to be free
They don't mind if it's more expensive
questions.answer: They don't mind if it's more expensive

questions.q: What service is requested?

reading.text: 台灣的郵局不僅可以寄信、寄包裹，還可以辦理儲蓄、保險和提款業務。郵局的提款機（ATM）在台灣非常普及，無論是在市區還是偏鄉，都很容易找到。此外，郵局現在也提供多種網購代收和配送服務，與民眾的生活息息相關。

questions.q: What services does the post office provide besides mail?
Are post office ATMs common in Taiwan?
Where can you find post office ATMs?
options: In both urban and rural areas
questions.answer: In both urban and rural areas

questions.q: What new services do post offices provide now?
Is the post office important to daily life in Taiwan?

title: Chapter 8: Opening a Bank Account
subtitle: Daily Life
entry_description: Learn the terminology for banking and finances.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想開一個新的銀行戶頭。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng kāi yīgè xīn de yínháng hùtóu.
dialogue.en: Hello, I would like to open a new bank account.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的。請問您目前在台灣工作還是讀書？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de. Qǐngwèn nín mùqián zài Táiwān gōngzuò háishì dúshū?
dialogue.en: Okay. Are you currently working or studying in Taiwan?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 我在一家科技公司工作。這是我的護照和居留證。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zài yī jiā kējì gōngsī gōngzuò. Zhè shì wǒ de hùzhào hé jūliúzhèng.
dialogue.en: I work at a tech company. Here are my passport and ARC.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。開戶需要「雙證件」，除了這兩個，您有健保卡嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè. Kāihù xūyào 'shuāng zhèngjiàn', chúle zhè liǎng gè, nín yǒu jiànbǎokǎ ma?
dialogue.en: Thank you. Opening an account requires 'dual ID'; besides these two, do you have a health insurance card?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 有的，給您。還需要準備印章嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu de, gěi nín. Hái xūyào zhǔnbèi yìnzhāng ma?
dialogue.en: Yes, here it is. Do I also need to prepare a seal?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 現在開戶可以用簽名的，不一定要用印章。不過有些文件還是需要您的親筆簽名。
dialogue.pinyin: Xiànzài kāihù kěyǐ yòng qiānmíng de, bù yīdìng yào yòng yìnzhāng. Bùguò yǒuxiē wénjiàn háishì xūyào nín de qīnbǐ qiānmíng.
dialogue.en: You can use a signature to open an account now; a seal is not strictly necessary. However, some documents still require your personal signature.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 好的。我想要申請提款卡，還有開通網路銀行。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de. Wǒ xiǎng yào shēnqǐng tíkuǎnkǎ, háiyǒu kāitōng wǎnglù yínháng.
dialogue.en: Okay. I want to apply for an ATM card and enable online banking.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。提款卡要大約一個禮拜後才能領取，網路銀行今天就能用。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Tíkuǎnkǎ yào dàyuē yīgè lǐbài hòu cáinéng lǐngqǔ, wǎnglù yínháng jīntiān jiù néng yòng.
dialogue.en: No problem. The ATM card can be picked up in about a week, but online banking can be used starting today.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 太好了。開戶需要先存一點錢嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le. Kāihù xūyào xiān cún yīdiǎn qián ma?
dialogue.en: Great. Do I need to deposit some money first to open the account?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 是的，請至少存入一千元台幣作為開戶金。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì de, qǐng zhìshǎo cúnrù yī qiān yuán Táibì zuòwéi kāihù jīn.
dialogue.en: Yes, please deposit at least 1000 NTD as the initial deposit.

listening.text: 請在這邊簽名，然後在鍵盤上輸入你的六位數密碼。這個密碼很重要，請不要告訴別人。如果你忘記了，需要本人帶證件來銀行重新設定。

questions.q: What should the person do first?
How many digits is the password?
What is the advice regarding the password?
What if the person forgets the password?
options: Come in person with ID to reset it
questions.answer: Come in person with ID to reset it

questions.q: Where should the password be entered?

reading.text: 在外國人要在台灣銀行開戶，通常需要準備「雙證件」，也就是護照加上居留證或是健保卡。此外，有些銀行會要求你提供工作證明或是學生證明，以確認開戶的目的。建議開戶前先打電話去銀行詢問需要帶哪些文件，以免多跑一趟。

questions.q: What does '雙證件' refer to for foreigners?
options: Two copies of the same ID
Two different forms of ID (e.g., Passport + ARC)
questions.answer: Two different forms of ID (e.g., Passport + ARC)

questions.q: Besides IDs, what other document might be required?
options: Proof of employment or student status
questions.answer: Proof of employment or student status

questions.q: Why is it recommended to call the bank beforehand?
options: To confirm which documents are needed
questions.answer: To confirm which documents are needed

questions.q: What is the purpose of asking for employment or student proof?
options: To confirm the purpose of opening the account
To see if you are famous
questions.answer: To confirm the purpose of opening the account

questions.q: Which of these is NOT mentioned as a possible ID?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 我想把這五百塊美金換成台幣。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè wǔ bǎi kuài Měijīn huànchéng Táibì.
dialogue.en: I want to exchange these 500 US dollars for NTD.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。請給我您的護照。請問您在我們銀行有戶頭嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Qǐng gěi wǒ nín de hùzhào. Qǐngwèn nín zài wǒmen yínháng yǒu hùtóu ma?
dialogue.en: No problem. Please give me your passport. Do you have an account at our bank?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 有的，這是我的存摺。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu de, zhè shì wǒ de cúnzhé.
dialogue.en: Yes, here is my passbook.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 如果有戶頭，匯率會稍微好一點。今天的匯率是三十一點五。
dialogue.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu hùtóu, huìlǜ huì shāowéi hǎo yīdiǎn. Jīntiān de huìlǜ shì sānshíyī diǎn wǔ.
dialogue.en: If you have an account, the exchange rate will be slightly better. Today's exchange rate is 31.5.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 換錢需要收手續費嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Huànqián xūyào shōu shǒuxùfèi ma?
dialogue.en: Is there a service fee for exchanging money?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 每筆交易要收一百元台幣的手續費。您可以接受嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Měi bǐ jiāoyì yào shōu yī bǎi yuán Táibì de shǒuxùfèi. Nín kěyǐ jiēshòu ma?
dialogue.en: There's a 100 NTD service fee for each transaction. Can you accept that?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 可以。那換完之後大約是多少台幣？
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ. Nà huàn wán zhīhòu dàyuē shì duōshǎo Táibì?
dialogue.en: Yes. So about how much NTD will it be after exchanging?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 扣掉手續費，一共是一萬五千六百五十元。
dialogue.pinyin: Kòudiào shǒuxùfèi, yīgòng shì yī wàn wǔ qiān liù bǎi wǔshí yuán.
dialogue.en: After deducting the service fee, it's 15,650 NTD in total.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 好的，請幫我換。我想多拿一些一百元的鈔票。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng bāng wǒ huàn. Wǒ xiǎng duō ná yīxiē yī bǎi yuán de chāopiào.
dialogue.en: Okay, please exchange it for me. I'd like to have more 100 NTD bills.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。給您，請當面點清金額。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Gěi nín, qǐng dāngmiàn diǎnqīng jīné.
dialogue.en: No problem. Here you go, please count the money in front of me.

listening.text: 現在換錢需要手續費一百元，而且每個人每天有限額。如果您需要換大量的金額，可能需要提前預約。換完錢後，收據請務必保留。

questions.q: How much is the service fee for exchanging money?
What is the policy for daily transactions?
options: There is a daily limit (限額)
questions.answer: There is a daily limit (限額)

entry_description: Talk about your family members and relationships.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.zh: 你有兄弟姊妹嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu xiōngdì zǐmèi ma?
dialogue.en: Do you have siblings?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 我有兩個哥哥和一個妹妹。我排行老三。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng gè gēgē hé yīgè mèimei. Wǒ páiháng lǎosān.
dialogue.en: I have two older brothers and one younger sister. I'm the third child.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.zh: 哇，大家庭！你哥哥們都做什麼工作？
dialogue.pinyin: Wa, dà jiātíng! Nǐ gēgēmen dōu zuò shénme gōngzuò?
dialogue.en: Wow, a big family! What do your brothers do for a living?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 大哥是工程師，二哥還在讀研究所。
dialogue.pinyin: Dàgē shì gōngchéngshī, èrgē hái zài dú yánjiūsuǒ.
dialogue.en: My oldest brother is an engineer, and my second brother is still in graduate school.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.zh: 那你父母也住在台灣嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nǐ fùmǔ yě zhù zài Táiwān ma?
dialogue.en: Do your parents also live in Taiwan?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 不，他們住在加拿大。他們在那裡已經住很久了。
dialogue.pinyin: Bù, tāmen zhù zài Jiānádà. Tāmen zài nàlǐ yǐjīng zhù hěn jiǔ le.
dialogue.en: No, they live in Canada. They've lived there for a long time.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.zh: 那你會常回加拿大看他們嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nǐ huì cháng huí Jiānádà kàn tāmen ma?
dialogue.en: Do you often go back to Canada to see them?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 一年大約回去一次，通常是在過聖誕節的時候。
dialogue.pinyin: Yī nián dàyuē huíqù yī cì, tōngcháng shì zài guò Shèngdànjié de shíhòu.
dialogue.en: About once a year, usually during Christmas.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.zh: 真不錯。那妹妹呢？她在做什麼？
dialogue.pinyin: Zhēn bùcuò. Nà mèimei ne? Tā zài zuò shénme?
dialogue.en: Nice. What about your younger sister? What is she doing?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 她還在讀中學，明年就要考大學了。
dialogue.pinyin: Tā hái zài dú zhōngxué, míngnián jiù yào kǎo dàxué le.
dialogue.en: She's still in secondary school; she'll be taking the university entrance exam next year.

listening.text: 我的家有五個人：爸爸、媽媽、姊姊、弟弟和我。爸爸在醫院工作，媽媽是家管。姊姊去年結婚了，現在住在高雄。弟弟還是大學生。

dialogue.speaker: Colleague
dialogue.zh: 你來台灣多久了？結婚了嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ lái Táiwān duōjiǔ le? Jiéhūn le ma?
dialogue.en: How long have you been in Taiwan? Are you married?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 我來兩年了。我還沒結婚，不過我現在有女朋友。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ lái liǎng nián le. Wǒ hái méi jiéhūn, bùguò wǒ xiànzài yǒu nǚ péngyǒu.
dialogue.en: I've been here for two years. I'm not married yet, but I have a girlfriend now.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？恭喜！她也是外國人嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Gōngxǐ! Tā yěshì wàiguórén ma?
dialogue.en: Really? Congratulations! Is she also a foreigner?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 不，她是台灣人。我們是在語言交換聚會認識的。
dialogue.pinyin: Bù, tā shì Táiwān rén. Wǒmen shì zài yǔyán jiāohuàn jùhuì rènshì de.
dialogue.en: No, she is Taiwanese. We met at a language exchange meeting.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague
dialogue.zh: 那很棒耶！你們打算什麼時候結婚？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà hěn bàng yé! Nǐmen dǎsuàn shénme shíhòu jiéhūn?
dialogue.en: That's great! When do you plan to get married?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 目前還沒有具體的計畫。我們想先多相處一段時間。
dialogue.pinyin: Mùqián hái méiyǒu jùtǐ de jìhuà. Wǒmen xiǎng xiān duō xiāngchǔ yīduàn shíjiān.
dialogue.en: No specific plans yet. We want to spend more time together first.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague
dialogue.zh: 也是。那你有打算在台灣買房定居嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Yěshì. Nà nǐ yǒu dǎsuàn zài Táiwān mǎifáng dìngjū ma?
dialogue.en: True. Do you plan to buy a house and settle down in Taiwan?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 這是一個大問題。台灣的房價好貴啊！
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè shì yīgè dà wèntí. Táiwān de fángjià hǎo guì a!
dialogue.en: That's a big question. Housing prices in Taiwan are so expensive!

dialogue.speaker: Colleague
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，特別是台北。那你家人支持你留在這裡嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Méicuò, tèbié shì Táiběi. Nà nǐ jiārén zhīchí nǐ liú zài zhèlǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Exactly, especially in Taipei. Do your family members support you staying here?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 他們很支持，只要我開心就好。他們也很喜歡台灣。
dialogue.pinyin: Tāmen hěn zhīchí, zhǐyào wǒ kāixīn jiù hǎo. Tāmen yě hěn xǐhuān Táiwān.
dialogue.en: They are very supportive; as long as I'm happy, it's fine. They also like Taiwan very much.

listening.text: 我哥哥去年結婚了，他現在有一個可愛的女兒。他的太太是一位老師，人非常溫柔。他們現在住在台北車站附近，交通很方便。

title: Chapter 10: Introducing Friends
subtitle: People & Places
entry_description: Learn to introduce your friends and acquaintances.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.zh: 大家請看，這是我最好的朋友，David。他剛從美國回來。
dialogue.pinyin: Dàjiā qǐng kàn, zhè shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, David. Tā gāng cóng Měiguó huílái.
dialogue.en: Everyone look, this is my best friend, David. He just came back from the USA.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 你好，David！很高興認識你。你在那裡住多久了？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, David! Hěn gāoxìng rènshì nǐ. Nǐ zài nàlǐ zhù duōjiǔ le?
dialogue.en: Hello, David! Nice to meet you. How long did you live there?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我在那裡住了五年。我也很高興見到大家。這是我從美國帶回來的一點心意。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zài nàlǐ zhù le wǔ nián. Wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng jiàn dào dàjiā. Zhè shì wǒ cóng Měiguó dài huílái de yīdiǎn xīnyì.
dialogue.en: I lived there for five years. I'm also very happy to meet everyone. This is a small token of appreciation I brought back from the USA.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，David！你太客氣了。大家隨便坐，不要拘束。
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè nǐ, David! Nǐ tài kèqì le. Dàjiā suíbiàn zuò, bùyào jūshù.
dialogue.en: Thank you, David! You are too kind. Everyone please sit anywhere, make yourselves at home.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: David，聽說你是學攝影的？
dialogue.pinyin: David, tīngshuō nǐ shì xué shèyǐng de?
dialogue.en: David, I heard you studied photography?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對，我很喜歡到處拍照。這是我的一大愛好。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, wǒ hěn xǐhuān dàochù pāizhào. Zhè shì wǒ de yī dà àihào.
dialogue.en: Yes, I love taking photos everywhere. It's a big hobby of mine.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 那下次有空，可以給我們大家拍張全家福嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà xià cì yǒu kòng, kěyǐ gěi wǒmen dàjiā pāi zhāng quánjiāfú ma?
dialogue.en: Then next time you're free, can you take a family photo for all of us?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 當然沒問題！我最喜歡幫人拍照了。
dialogue.pinyin: Dāngrán méi wèntí! Wǒ zuì xǐhuān bāng rén pāizhào le.
dialogue.en: Of course, no problem! I love taking photos of people the most.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.zh: 太好了。David，來喝點茶，這是我剛買的烏龍茶。
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le. David, lái hē diǎn chá, zhè shì wǒ gāng mǎi de wūlóngchá.
dialogue.en: Great. David, come have some tea, this is Oolong tea I just bought.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好香啊，謝謝你。在美國很難喝到這麼道地的茶。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo xiāng a, xièxiè nǐ. Zài Měiguó hěn nán hē dào zhème dàodì de chá.
dialogue.en: Smells so good, thank you. It's hard to get such authentic tea in the USA.

dialogue.pinyin: Tā zài yī jiā shèjì gōngsī dāng shèjìshī. Tā de zuòpǐn dōu hěn piàoliang.

dialogue.speaker: Friend B

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian

dialogue.pinyin: Shì de. Yánzhe zhè tiáo lù zhí zǒu, dào dì èr gè dà lùkǒu yòuzhuǎn.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist

dialogue.pinyin: Yòuzhuǎn zhīhòu hái yào zǒu hěn jiǔ ma?
dialogue.en: Do I have to walk for a long time after turning right?

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian

Ask a pedestrian, or visit a convenience store or police station

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 請問這附近有藥局嗎？我需要買感冒藥。
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn zhè fùjìn yǒu yàojú ma? Wǒ xūyào mǎi gǎnmàoyào.
dialogue.en: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy nearby? I need to buy cold medicine.

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.zh: 有的，前面右轉那條街上就有一家連鎖藥局。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu de, qiánmiàn yòuzhuǎn nà tiáo jiē shàng jiù yǒu yī jiā liánsuǒ yàojú.
dialogue.en: Yes, there is a chain pharmacy on that street after turning right ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 請問走路大概要多久？
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn zǒulù dàgài yào duōjiǔ?
dialogue.en: About how long does it take to walk there?

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.zh: 走路的話大約要十五到二十分鐘，稍微有點遠。
dialogue.pinyin: Zǒulù de huà dàyuē yào shíwǔ dào èrshí fēnzhōng, shāowéi yǒudiǎn yuǎn.
dialogue.en: By walking, it takes about 15 to 20 minutes; it's a bit far.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 那如果我騎YouBike去會比較快嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà rúguǒ wǒ qí YouBike qù huì bǐjiào kuài ma?
dialogue.en: Then would it be faster if I ride a YouBike?

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.zh: 會快很多！大約五分鐘就到了。前面捷運站出口就有借車點。
dialogue.pinyin: Huì kuài hěnduō! Dàyuē wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Qiánmiàn jiéyùnzhàn chūkǒu jiù yǒu jièchē diǎn.
dialogue.en: It will be much faster! You'll be there in about 5 minutes. There's a rental station at the MRT station exit ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那附近有還車的地點嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le. Nà fùjìn yǒu huánchē de dìdiǎn ma?
dialogue.en: Great. Is there a return station near there?

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.zh: 有的，藥局旁邊的超市門口就可以還車。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu de, yàojú pángbiān de chāoshì ménkǒu jiù kěyǐ huánchē.
dialogue.en: Yes, you can return the bike at the entrance of the supermarket next to the pharmacy.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的建議。騎車確實比較方便。
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè nǐ de jiànyì. Qíchē quèshí bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
dialogue.en: Thank you for your suggestion. Riding is indeed more convenient.

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。注意安全，祝你感冒早日康復！
dialogue.pinyin: Bù kèqì. Zhùyì ānquán, zhù nǐ gǎnmào zǎorì kāngfù!
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Be safe, and I hope you recover from your cold soon!

listening.text: 這附近停車非常困難，路邊都沒有停車位。你可能需要把車停到兩個街區以外的大型立體停車場，然後再走過來。那個停車場每小時收費六十元。

title: Chapter 12: Travel & Hotel
subtitle: People & Places
entry_description: Learn phrases for traveling and staying at hotels.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 歡迎光臨，請問有預約嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Huānyíng guānglín, qǐngwèn yǒu yùyuē ma?
dialogue.en: Welcome, do you have a reservation?

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 有，我姓王，預約了兩晚的雙人房。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu, wǒ xìng Wáng, yùyuē le liǎng wǎn de shuāngrénfáng.
dialogue.en: Yes, my surname is Wang, I booked a double room for two nights.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 好的，王先生，請出示您的護照或身分證。我們需要影印一下。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, Wáng xiānshēng, qǐng chūshì nín de hùzhào huò shēnfènzhèng. Wǒmen xūyào yǐngyìn yīxià.
dialogue.en: Okay, Mr. Wang, please show your passport or ID. We need to make a copy.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 給您。請問房費包含早餐嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Gěi nín. Qǐngwèn fángfèi bāohán zǎocān ma?
dialogue.en: Here you go. Does the room rate include breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 有的，早餐在二樓餐廳，供應時間是早上七點到十點。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu de, zǎocān zài èr lóu chāntīng, gōngyìng shíjiān shì zǎoshàng qī diǎn dào shí diǎn.
dialogue.en: Yes, breakfast is in the second-floor restaurant, served from 7 AM to 10 AM.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。房間裡有免費的Wi-Fi嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè. Fángjiān lǐ yǒu miǎnfèi de Wi-Fi ma?
dialogue.en: Thank you. Is there free Wi-Fi in the room?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 有，密碼寫在房卡套上面。這是您的房卡，房間在十樓。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu, mìmǎ xiě zài fángkǎtào shàngmiàn. Zhè shì nín de fángkǎ, fángjiān zài shí lóu.
dialogue.en: Yes, the password is written on the room card holder. Here is your room card; your room is on the 10th floor.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 好的。另外，我想寄放行李，可以嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de. Lìngwài, wǒ xiǎng jìfàng xínglǐ, kěyǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Also, I'd like to store my luggage, is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，您可以把行李交給那邊的服務生。
dialogue.pinyin: Dāngrán kěyǐ, nín kěyǐ bǎ xínglǐ jiāogěi nàbiān de fúwùshēng.
dialogue.en: Of course, you can hand your luggage to the waiter over there.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 太感謝了。請問退房時間是幾點？
dialogue.pinyin: Tài gǎnxiè le. Qǐngwèn tuìfáng shíjiān shì jǐ diǎn?
dialogue.en: Thank you so much. What time is check-out?

listening.text: 飯店的退房時間是早上十一點。如果您需要寄放行李，可以告訴櫃檯。另外，如果您需要叫計程車去機場，也請提前通知我們，我們會幫您安排。

When should you notify them about the taxi?

reading.text: 這家五星級飯店的設施非常完備。頂樓有一個露天游泳池，可以一邊游泳一邊欣賞城市風景。地下一樓有健身房和三溫暖，對住房客人是免費開放的。房間內提供高速Wi-Fi和膠囊咖啡機。此外，飯店的地理位置優越，就在捷運站旁邊，不論去逛街還是參觀景點都非常方便。

What electronic items are mentioned in the room?

questions.answer: It's right next to an MRT station

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想參加明天的太魯閣一日遊。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng cānjiā míngtiān de Tàilǔgé yī rì yóu.
dialogue.en: Hello, I want to join tomorrow's Taroko Gorge one-day tour.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，這是一個非常受歡迎的行程。請問有幾位要參加？
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, zhè shì yīgè fēicháng shòu huānyíng de xíngchéng. Qǐngwèn yǒu jǐ wèi yào cānjiā?
dialogue.en: No problem, this is a very popular itinerary. How many people will join?

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 我們有兩個人。早上在哪裡集合？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu liǎng gè rén. Zǎoshàng zài nǎlǐ jíhé?
dialogue.en: There are two of us. Where do we gather in the morning?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 早上八點準時在飯店大廳集合，導遊會拿著紅色的旗子。
dialogue.pinyin: Zǎoshàng bā diǎn zhǔnshí zài fàndiàn dàtīng jíhé, dǎoyóu huì názhe hóngsè de qízi.
dialogue.en: Gather in the hotel lobby promptly at 8 AM; the guide will be holding a red flag.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 好的。一日遊的費用是多少？包含午餐嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de. Yī rì yóu de fèiyòng shì duōshǎo? Bāohán wǔcān ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. How much is the one-day tour? Does it include lunch?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 一個人是一千八百元，費用包含交通、導遊服務、午餐和國家公園門票。
dialogue.pinyin: Yīgè rén shì yī qiān bā bǎi yuán, fèiyòng bāohán jiāotōng, dǎoyóu fúwù, wǔcān hé guójiā gōngyuán ménpiào.
dialogue.en: It's 1800 NTD per person; the fee includes transportation, guide services, lunch, and national park entrance tickets.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 那午餐是吃什麼？我有吃素的朋友。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà wǔcān shì chī shénme? Wǒ yǒu chīsù de péngyǒu.
dialogue.en: What's for lunch? I have a friend who is vegetarian.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 午餐是當地的特色風味餐。如果您有朋友吃素，我們可以提前通知餐廳準備素食。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǔcān shì dāngdì de tèsè fēngwèicān. Rúguǒ nín yǒu péngyǒu chīsù, wǒmen kěyǐ tíqián tōngzhī chāntīng zhǔnbèi sùshí.
dialogue.en: Lunch is a local specialty meal. If you have a friend who is vegetarian, we can notify the restaurant in advance to prepare vegetarian food.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那就報名兩位。可以用刷卡付費嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, nà jiù bàomíng liǎng wèi. Kěyǐ yòng shuākǎ fùfèi ma?
dialogue.en: Great, then sign up two people. Can I pay by credit card?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 可以的，請到櫃檯辦理。提醒您，山上天氣變化大，記得帶件外套和雨具。
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ de, qǐng dào guìtái bànlǐ. Tíxǐng nín, shānshàng tiānqì biànhuà dà, jìde dài jiàn wàitào hé yǔjù.
dialogue.en: Yes, please go to the counter to handle it. A reminder, the weather on the mountain changes quickly; remember to bring a jacket and rain gear.

listening.text: 如果你要去阿里山看日出，一定要記得帶厚外套，因為山上的氣溫比平地低很多。此外，建議穿一雙好走路的鞋子，因為會走比較多的山路。

What should they bring and why?

reading.text: 台灣擁有多元且美麗的風景區。東部有壯麗的太魯閣峽谷和太平洋，南部有充滿陽光的墾丁海灘，中部則有美麗的日月潭和阿里山雲海。不論你喜歡爬山還是看海，在台灣都能找到合適的旅遊地點。此外，台灣的交通十分便捷，利用高鐵和捷運就能輕鬆到達許多著名的景點。

title: Chapter 13: Job Interview
subtitle: Work & Study
entry_description: Prepare for a job interview in a Mandarin-speaking environment.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 王先生你好，請坐。請你先做一下簡短的自我介紹。
dialogue.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng nǐ hǎo, qǐng zuò. Qǐng nǐ xiān zuò yīxià jiǎnduǎn de zìwǒ jièshào.
dialogue.en: Hello Mr. Wang, please sit down. Please start with a brief self-introduction.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 您好。我叫Mark，畢業於美國國立大學，主修市場行銷。
dialogue.pinyin: Nín hǎo. Wǒ jiào Mark, bìyè yú Měiguó Guólì Dàxué, zhǔxiū shìchǎng hángxiāo.
dialogue.en: Hello. My name is Mark, I graduated from USA National University, majoring in marketing.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 你的學歷很不錯。請問你為什麼想來我們公司工作？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ de xuélì hěn bùcuò. Qǐngwèn nǐ wèishéme xiǎng lái wǒmen gōngsī gōngzuò?
dialogue.en: Your educational background is very good. Why do you want to work for our company?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 貴公司在科技領域很有名，我一直很嚮往這裡的企業文化。
dialogue.pinyin: Guì gōngsī zài kējì lǐngyù hěn yǒumíng, wǒ yīzhí hěn xiàngwǎng zhèlǐ de qǐyè wénhuà.
dialogue.en: Your company is very famous in the tech field, and I have always admired the corporate culture here.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 你有相關的工作經驗嗎？或者實習經驗？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu xiāngguān de gōngzuò jīngyàn ma? Huòzhě shíxí jīngyàn?
dialogue.en: Do you have relevant work experience? Or internship experience?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 我有三年的行銷經驗，之前在一家跨國公司擔任專案助理。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu sān nián de hángxiāo jīngyàn, zhīqián zài yī jiā kuàguó gōngsī dānrèn zhuā'àn zhùlǐ.
dialogue.en: I have three years of marketing experience, and previously served as a project assistant at a multinational company.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 那你的語言能力如何？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nǐ de yǔyán nénglì rúhé?
dialogue.en: How are your language skills?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 我的母語是英文，也能流利地使用中文進行商務溝通。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ de mǔyǔ shì Yīngwén, yě néng liúlì de shǐyòng Zhōngwén jìnxíng shāngwù gōutōng.
dialogue.en: My native language is English, and I can also fluently use Chinese for business communication.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 很好。你對這份工作有什麼特別的期望嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hěn hǎo. Nǐ duì zhè fèn gōngzuò yǒu shéme tèbié de qīwàng ma?
dialogue.en: Very good. Do you have any special expectations for this job?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 我希望能發揮我的專業能力，與團隊一起達成公司的目標。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng néng fāhuī wǒ de zhuānyè nénglì, yǔ tuánduì yīqǐ dáchéng gōngsī de mùbiāo.
dialogue.en: I hope to utilize my professional skills and work with the team to achieve the company's goals.

listening.text: 我們正在尋找一位有責任心、團隊合作能力強且具備良好溝通技巧的人才。如果你具備這些特質，並且有兩年以上的工作經驗，歡迎加入我們。

questions.q: What qualities is the company looking for?
options: Responsible, good teamwork, and communication skills
questions.answer: Responsible, good teamwork, and communication skills

questions.q: What kind of ability is specifically mentioned?
How much work experience is required?
options: More than two years (兩年以上)
questions.answer: More than two years (兩年以上)

questions.q: Is the company currently hiring?
What is the primary focus of the announcement?

reading.text: 面試是找工作最重要的環節之一。面試時，服裝要整齊得體，這能顯示你對這份工作的尊重。態度要誠懇，回答問題時要保持自信。除了回答面試官的問題，你也可以準備幾個問題問面試官，例如關於公司的發展前景、團隊氛圍或是員工福利。這能顯示你對這家公司的濃厚興趣。

questions.q: What is considered the most important part of job hunting?
How should you dress for an interview?
What should your attitude be during the interview?
Can you ask the interviewer questions?
What are some example topics to ask about?
options: Company development, team atmosphere, and benefits
questions.answer: Company development, team atmosphere, and benefits

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 你覺得你最大的優點是什麼？這對我們公司有什麼幫助？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ juédé nǐ zuìdà de yōudiǎn shì shénme? Zhè duì wǒmen gōngsī yǒu shéme bāngzhù?
dialogue.en: What do you think is your greatest strength? How can this help our company?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 我學習新事物的速度很快，而且做事非常細心，很少出錯。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xuéxí xīn shìwù de sùdù hěn kuài, érqiě zuòshì fēicháng xìxīn, hěn shǎo chūcuò.
dialogue.en: I learn new things very quickly, and I am very meticulous in my work, rarely making mistakes.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很不錯。那談談你的缺點呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái hěn bùcuò. Nà tántán nǐ de quēdiǎn ne?
dialogue.en: Sounds good. Now tell me about your weaknesses.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 有時候我太過於追求完美，可能會在細節上花比較多時間。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒushíhòu wǒ tàiguò yú zhuīqiú wánměi, kěnéng huì zài xìjié shàng huā bǐjiào duō shíjiān.
dialogue.en: Sometimes I pursue perfection too much and might spend more time on details.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 那你是如何改進這個缺點的？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nǐ shì rúhé gǎijìn zhège quēdiǎn de?
dialogue.en: How are you improving on this weakness?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 我現在學會排定事情的優先順序，確保最重要的工作能準時完成。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài xuéhuì páidìng shìqíng de yōuxiān shùnxù, quèbǎo zuì zhòngyào de gōngzuò néng zhǔnshí wánchéng.
dialogue.en: I have learned to prioritize tasks to ensure the most important work is completed on time.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 很好。面對壓力的時後，你會怎麼處理？
dialogue.pinyin: Hěn hǎo. Miànduì yālì de shíhòu, nǐ huì zěnme chǔlǐ?
dialogue.en: Good. How do you handle pressure?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 我會先深呼吸，理清思路，然後一步步解決問題。運動也是我減壓的方式。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ huì xiān shēnhūxī, lǐqīng sīlù, ránhòu yībùbù jiějué wèntí. Yùndòng yěshì wǒ jiǎnyā de fāngshì.
dialogue.en: I take a deep breath, clear my thoughts, and then solve problems step by step. Exercise is also my way to relieve stress.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 最後一個問題，你對薪資有什麼要求嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Zuìhòu yīgè wèntí, nǐ duì xīnzī yǒu shéme yāoqiú ma?
dialogue.en: Last question, what are your salary requirements?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 根據我的經驗和市場水平，我期望的月薪是大約六萬到七萬元台幣。
dialogue.pinyin: Gēnjù wǒ de jīngyàn hé shìchǎng shuǐpíng, wǒ qīwàng de yuèxīn shì dàyuē liù wàn dào qī wàn yuán Táibì.
dialogue.en: Based on my experience and market standards, my expected monthly salary is about 60,000 to 70,000 NTD.

listening.text: 如果你被錄取了，我們希望你能在兩個星期內報到。此外，試用期為三個月，期間會有資深同事指導你的工作。

title: Chapter 14: Office Talk
subtitle: Work & Study
entry_description: Communicate effectively with colleagues in an office setting.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我的電腦好像有點問題，你可以幫我看一下嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ de diànnǎo hǎoxiàng yǒudiǎn wèntí, nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ kàn yīxià ma?
dialogue.en: Sorry, my computer seems to have a problem; can you help me take a look?

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。是軟體打不開，還是不能連上網路？
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Shì ruǎntǐ dǎ bù kāi, háishì bùnéng lián shàng wǎnglù?
dialogue.en: No problem. Is it that the software won't open, or you can't connect to the internet?

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.zh: 好像是印表機連不到。我需要印這份會議資料。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎoxiàng shì yìngbiǎojī lián bù dào. Wǒ xūyào yìn zhè fèn huìyì zīliào.
dialogue.en: It seems I can't connect to the printer. I need to print these meeting materials.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.zh: 喔，那可能是網路印表機斷線了。你重開一下試試看。
dialogue.pinyin: Ō, nà kěnéng shì wǎnglù yìngbiǎojī duànxiàn le. Nǐ chóngkāi yīxià shìshì kàn.
dialogue.en: Oh, then the network printer might be disconnected. Try restarting it.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.zh: 我重開過了，但還是不行。你能幫我印嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ chóngkāi guò le, dàn háishì bùxíng. Nǐ néng bāng wǒ yìn ma?
dialogue.en: I restarted it, but it's still not working. Can you print it for me?

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.zh: 好，你把檔案寄給我，我幫你印。要印幾份？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, nǐ bǎ dǎng'àn jì gěi wǒ, wǒ bāng nǐ yìn. Yào yìn jǐ fèn?
dialogue.en: Sure, send the file to me and I'll print it for you. How many copies?

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.zh: 一共要五份，都要雙面列印，謝謝你。
dialogue.pinyin: Yīgòng yào wǔ fèn, dōu yào shuāngmiàn lièyìn, xièxiè nǐ.
dialogue.en: Five copies in total, double-sided printing for all, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。對了，你知道印表機的紙在哪裡嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Duì le, nǐ zhīdào yìngbiǎojī de zhǐ zài nǎlǐ ma?
dialogue.en: No problem. By the way, do you know where the printer paper is?

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.zh: 就在飲水機旁邊的櫃子裡。我現在去拿一包。
dialogue.pinyin: Jiù zài yǐnshuǐjī pángbiān de guìzi lǐ. Wǒ xiànzài qù ná yī bāo.
dialogue.en: It's right in the cabinet next to the water dispenser. I'll go grab a pack now.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.zh: 太好了，紙快沒了。印好我再通知你。
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, zhǐ kuài méi le. Yìn hǎo wǒ zài tōngzhī nǐ.
dialogue.en: Great, paper is almost out. I'll notify you when it's printed.

listening.text: 各位同事請注意，今天下午三點在第一會議室有一個緊急會議，請大家準時參加。另外，會議前請先閱讀我寄出的電子郵件。

reading.text: 在辦公室工作中，團隊溝通與合作是成功的關鍵。當你遇到工作上的困難時，不要害怕向同事或主管尋求幫助。主動的溝通可以避免誤解，並確保專案進度不受影響。此外，保持工作環境的整潔以及準時參加會議，也是專業素養的表現。

questions.q: What is key to success in the office?
options: Team communication and cooperation (團隊溝通與合作)
questions.answer: Team communication and cooperation (團隊溝通與合作)

questions.q: Should you be afraid to ask for help?
options: No, don't be afraid (不要害怕)
Only if you are a manager
questions.answer: No, don't be afraid (不要害怕)

questions.q: What can proactive communication avoid?
What does being on time for meetings show?
What else is mentioned as a sign of professionalism?
options: Keeping the workspace clean (保持環境整潔)
questions.answer: Keeping the workspace clean (保持環境整潔)

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 小王，你寄電子郵件給那個重要的客戶了嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng, nǐ jì diànzǐ yóujiàn gěi nàge zhòngyào de kèhù le ma?
dialogue.en: Xiao Wang, did you send the email to that important client?

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 還沒，經理。我正在確認報價單上的金額是否有誤。
dialogue.pinyin: Hái méi, jīnglǐ. Wǒ zhèngzài quèrèn bàojiàdān shàng de jīné shìfǒu yǒuwù.
dialogue.en: Not yet, manager. I'm currently confirming if the amounts on the quotation are correct.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 很好。確認完畢後，請趕快寄出去。他們下午有會，需要看這份資料。
dialogue.pinyin: Hěn hǎo. Quèrèn wánbì hòu, qǐng gǎnkuài jì chūqù. Tāmen xiàwǔ yǒu huì, xūyào kàn zhè fèn zīliào.
dialogue.en: Good. After confirmation, please send it out quickly. They have a meeting this afternoon and need to see this data.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 好的，我十分鐘內就會寄出。我會抄送給您一份。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ shí fēnzhōng nèi jiù huì jì chū. Wǒ huì chāosòng gěi nín yī fèn.
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll send it within ten minutes. I'll CC a copy to you.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 對了，你有附上我們公司的新產品型錄嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Duì le, nǐ yǒu fù shàng wǒmen gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn xínglù ma?
dialogue.en: By the way, did you attach our company's new product catalog?

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 啊，差點忘了！謝謝經理提醒，我會一起附在附件中。
dialogue.pinyin: A, chàdiǎn wàng le! Xièxiè jīnglǐ tíxǐng, wǒ huì yīqǐ fù zài fùjiàn zhōng.
dialogue.en: Ah, I almost forgot! Thanks for the reminder, manager, I'll include it in the attachments.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。信件的主旨要寫明確一點，讓客戶一眼就看到。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Xìnjiàn de zhǔzhǐ yào xiě míngquè yīdiǎn, ràng kèhù yīyǎn jiù kàn dào.
dialogue.en: No problem. The subject of the email should be clear so the client sees it immediately.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 我知道了。我會寫「關於新專案的報價單與產品資料」。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào le. Wǒ huì xiě 'Guānyú xīn zhuā'àn de bàojiàdān yǔ chǎnpǐn zīliào'.
dialogue.en: I see. I'll write 'Quotation and Product Info for the New Project'.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 這樣很好。寄出後記得在群組裡說一聲。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhèyàng hěn hǎo. Jì chū hòu jìde zài qúnzǔ lǐ shuō yī shēng.
dialogue.en: That's good. Remember to mention it in the group after sending.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，沒問題。我馬上處理。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, méi wèntí. Wǒ mǎshàng chǔlǐ.
dialogue.en: No problem, no problem. I'll handle it right away.

listening.text: 王經理您好，這是我這禮拜的工作進度報告，請您查收。如果您對內容有任何疑問，我們可以隨時討論。謝謝您。

reading.text: 撰寫商務郵件時，專業度至關重要。郵件的主旨應當簡明扼要，讓收件者能迅速了解郵件內容。正文部分要清晰、有條理，並使用合適的禮貌用語。在發送郵件前，務必仔細檢查是否有錯別字或語法錯誤。此外，確認附件是否正確上傳也是一個不可忽視的步驟。

title: Chapter 15: School & Classes
subtitle: Work & Study
entry_description: Common phrases and situations in an educational environment.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 嘿，你這學期選了什麼課？我還在糾結要選哪一門。
dialogue.pinyin: Hēi, nǐ zhè xuéqí xuǎn le shénme kè? Wǒ hái zài jiūjié yào xuǎn nǎ yī mén.
dialogue.en: Hey, what classes did you choose this semester? I'm still struggling with which one to pick.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 我選了中級漢語和中國文化。這兩門課看起來很有意思。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xuǎn le zhōngjí Hànyǔ hé Zhōngguó wénhuà. Zhè liǎng mén kè kàn qǐlái hěn yǒuyìsi.
dialogue.en: I chose Intermediate Chinese and Chinese Culture. These two classes seem very interesting.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 聽說文化課的作業非常多，而且期末還要做口頭報告，是真的嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Tīngshuō wénhuà kè de zuòyè fēicháng duō, érqiě qīmò hái yào zuò kǒutóu bàogào, shì zhēn de ma?
dialogue.en: I heard the culture class has a lot of homework, and there's an oral presentation at the end, is it true?

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 對，是真的，但是老師教得很好，而且課程內容很豐富。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, shì zhēn de, dànshì lǎoshī jiāo de hěn hǎo, érqiě kèchéng nèiróng hěn fēngfù.
dialogue.en: Yes, it's true, but the teacher teaches very well, and the course content is very rich.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 那中級漢語呢？會不會很難？我擔心我的聽力不夠好。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà zhōngjí Hànyǔ ne? Huì bù huì hěn nán? Wǒ dānxīn wǒ de tīnglì bùgòu hǎo.
dialogue.en: What about Intermediate Chinese? Is it difficult? I'm worried my listening isn't good enough.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 剛開始確實有點挑戰，但是如果你每天都練習，很快就能跟上。
dialogue.pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ quèshí yǒudiǎn tiǎozhàn, dànshì rúguǒ nǐ měitiān dōu liànxí, hěn kuài jiù néng gēn shàng.
dialogue.en: It's indeed a bit challenging at the beginning, but if you practice every day, you'll catch up quickly.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 這門課有期中考嗎？還是只有期末考？
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè mén kè yǒu qīzhōngkǎo ma? Háishì zhǐyǒu qīmòkǎo?
dialogue.en: Does this class have a mid-term exam? Or just a final exam?

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 兩者都有。而且平時的小考也很重要。
dialogue.pinyin: Liǎngzhě dōu yǒu. Érqiě píngshí de xiǎokǎo yě hěn zhòngyào.
dialogue.en: Both. And the regular quizzes are also very important.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 聽起來壓力不小。好吧，我想我還是會選文化課。
dialogue.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái yālì bù xiǎo. Hǎo ba, wǒ xiǎng wǒ háishì huì xuǎn wénhuà kè.
dialogue.en: Sounds like quite a bit of pressure. Well, I think I'll still choose the culture class.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 好啊，那我們就可以一起去圖書館讀書了！
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a, nà wǒmen jiù kěyǐ yīqǐ qù túshūguǎn dúshū le!
dialogue.en: Great, then we can go to the library to study together!

listening.text: 各位同學請注意，明天的中文考試因為學校停電，決定延期到下禮拜五。請大家利用這段時間好好複習。如果有任何問題，可以隨時寫郵件給我。

questions.q: What was postponed?
What was the reason for the postponement?
When is the new date for the exam?
What did the speaker suggest students do?
How can students contact the speaker?

reading.text: 學校圖書館是學生們學習和查閱資料的最佳場所。裡面環境安靜、採光充足，提供了大量的參考書和學術期刊。如果你想借書，必須攜帶有效的學生證。每人最多可以借十本書，借期為一個月。請務必準時歸還，否則會產生罰金。

questions.q: What is the library the best place for?
options: Studying and researching data (學習和查閱資料)
questions.answer: Studying and researching data (學習和查閱資料)

questions.q: What documents do you need to borrow books?
What is the maximum number of books one can borrow?
How long is the loan period for books?
What happens if you return books late?
options: You are banned from the library forever

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 老師，不好意思，我想請問一下這個字要怎麼讀？
dialogue.pinyin: Lǎoshī, bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ xiǎng qǐngwèn yīxià zhège zì yào zěnme dú?
dialogue.en: Teacher, sorry, I'd like to ask how to read this character?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 這個字讀'聽'，一聲，意思是'to listen'。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhège zì dú 'tīng', yīshēng, yìsi shì 'to listen'.
dialogue.en: This character is read as 'ting', first tone, it means 'to listen'.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師。那它的部首是什麼呢？看起來有點複雜。
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè lǎoshī. Nà tā de bùshǒu shì shénme ne? Kàn qǐlái yǒudiǎn fùzá.
dialogue.en: Thank you, teacher. What is its radical then? It looks a bit complex.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 它的部首是'耳'，耳朵的耳。很有意思吧？
dialogue.pinyin: Tā de bùshǒu shì 'ěr', ěrduo de ěr. Hěn yǒuyìsi ba?
dialogue.en: Its radical is 'ear'. Very interesting, right?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 原來如此。老師，可以請您再把這個句子讀一遍嗎？我想練習發音。
dialogue.pinyin: Yuánlái rúcǐ. Lǎoshī, kěyǐ qǐng nín zài bǎ zhège jùzi dú yībiàn ma? Wǒ xiǎng liànxí fāyīn.
dialogue.en: I see. Teacher, could you please read this sentence one more time? I want to practice my pronunciation.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，慢慢跟著我讀：'我喜歡聽音樂'。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, mànman gēnzhe wǒ dú: 'Wǒ xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè'.
dialogue.en: No problem, slowly follow me: 'I like listening to music'.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡聽音樂。老師，我的發音準確嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè. Lǎoshī, wǒ de fāyīn zhǔnquè ma?
dialogue.en: I like listening to music. Teacher, is my pronunciation accurate?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 很棒！特別是第三聲和第一聲的轉換，做得很好。
dialogue.pinyin: Hěn bàng! Tèbié shì dì sān shēng hé dì yī shēng de zhuǎnhuàn, zuò de hěn hǎo.
dialogue.en: Excellent! Especially the transition between the third and first tones; you did very well.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師的鼓勵。對了，這題作業我不太會寫。
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè lǎoshī de gǔlì. Duì le, zhè tí zuòyè wǒ bù tài huì xiě.
dialogue.en: Thank you for the encouragement, teacher. By the way, I don't quite know how to do this homework problem.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，下課後你來我辦公室，我再詳細跟你解釋。
dialogue.pinyin: Méiguānxì, xiàkè hòu nǐ lái wǒ bàngōngshì, wǒ zài xiángxì gēn nǐ jiěshì.
dialogue.en: No worries, come to my office after class, and I'll explain it to you in detail.

listening.text: 請大家翻到課本第五十頁，我們今天看第三課的語法部分。請先聽我讀一遍課文，然後大家分組練習對話。

title: Chapter 16: Workplace & Office Talk
subtitle: Work & Study
entry_description: Navigate complex discussions and project planning in a professional environment.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 大家早安，我們來討論一下這個新專案的進度。
dialogue.pinyin: Dàjiā zǎo'ān, wǒmen lái tǎolùn yīxià zhège xīn zhuā'àn de jìndù.
dialogue.en: Good morning everyone, let's discuss the progress of this new project.

dialogue.speaker: Employee A
dialogue.zh: 經理早。目前的市場調查已經完成，報告也寫好了。
dialogue.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zǎo. Mùqián de shìchǎng diàochá yǐjīng wánchéng, bàogào yě xiě hǎo le.
dialogue.en: Morning manager. The current market research is completed, and the report is written.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 很好，調查結果有什麼特別的發現嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hěn hǎo, diàochá jiéguǒ yǒu shénme tèbié de fāxiàn ma?
dialogue.en: Good, are there any special findings in the research results?

dialogue.speaker: Employee A
dialogue.zh: 我們發現年輕客群對這個產品非常感興趣，特別是大學生。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen fāxiàn niánqīng kèqún duì zhège chǎnpǐn fēicháng gǎn xìngqù, tèbié shì dàxuéshēng.
dialogue.en: We found that the younger demographic is very interested in this product, especially college students.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 這跟我們預期的一樣。那行銷部門有什麼計畫？
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè gēn wǒmen yùqí de yīyàng. Nà hángxiāo bùmén yǒu shénme jìhuà?
dialogue.en: This is as we expected. What plans does the marketing department have?

dialogue.speaker: Employee B
dialogue.zh: 我們打算在社群媒體上投放廣告，並邀請網紅合作。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn zài shèqún méitǐ shàng tóufàng guǎnggào, bìng yāoqǐng wǎnghóng hézuò.
dialogue.en: We plan to run ads on social media and invite influencers to collaborate.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 預算大概需要多少？
dialogue.pinyin: Yùsuàn dàgài xūyào duōshǎo?
dialogue.en: How much budget is roughly needed?

dialogue.speaker: Employee B
dialogue.zh: 初步估計需要五十萬台幣，但我們可以根據效果再做調整。
dialogue.pinyin: Chūbù gūjì xūyào wǔshí wàn Táibì, dàn wǒmen kěyǐ gēnjù xiàoguǒ zài zuò tiáozhěng.
dialogue.en: The initial estimate is 500,000 NTD, but we can adjust based on the results.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 好，請在下週一前把詳細的企劃書交給我。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, qǐng zài xià zhōu yī qián bǎ xiángxì de qìhuàshū jiāo gěi wǒ.
dialogue.en: Okay, please give me the detailed proposal before next Monday.

dialogue.speaker: Employee B
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我週末會加班把它趕出來。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, wǒ zhōumò huì jiābān bǎ tā gǎn chūlái.
dialogue.en: No problem, I will work overtime this weekend to rush it out.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 辛苦了，大家繼續努力，我們爭取下個月順利發表。
dialogue.pinyin: Xīnkǔ le, dàjiā jìxù nǔlì, wǒmen zhēngqǔ xià gè yuè shùnlì fābiǎo.
dialogue.en: Thanks for your hard work. Everyone keep it up, let's strive to successfully launch it next month.

listening.text: 明天早上的跨部門會議非常重要，請各部門主管務必準時出席。會議將討論明年度的產品開發計畫與預算分配。請記得攜帶相關的數據報表。

questions.q: What kind of meeting is taking place tomorrow morning?
Who must attend the meeting on time?
What will be discussed?
options: Product development plans and budget allocation
questions.answer: Product development plans and budget allocation

questions.q: What should attendees bring?
How important is this meeting?

reading.text: 在現代企業中，團隊合作是提升工作效率的關鍵。良好的溝通不僅能減少誤會，還能激發更多的創意。如果遇到跨部門的專案，大家必須互相配合，共享資源，才能達到雙贏的結果。公司也經常舉辦員工訓練，提升大家的專業技能。

questions.q: What is key to improving work efficiency?
What is a benefit of good communication?
What must be done in cross-departmental projects?
What is the ultimate goal of sharing resources?
Why does the company often hold employee training?

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.zh: 你好，我們看過你們的產品型錄了，對那款新手機很有興趣。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒmen kàn guò nǐmen de chǎnpǐn xínglù le, duì nà kuǎn xīn shǒujī hěn yǒu xìngqù.
dialogue.en: Hello, we have looked at your product catalog and are very interested in that new mobile phone.

dialogue.speaker: Sales
dialogue.zh: 很高興你們喜歡！請問這次預計訂購的數量大概是多少？
dialogue.pinyin: Hěn gāoxìng nǐmen xǐhuān! Qǐngwèn zhè cì yùjì dìnggòu de shùliàng dàgài shì duōshǎo?
dialogue.en: Glad you like it! What is the estimated order quantity this time?

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.zh: 我們第一批打算先訂一千支，看看市場反應。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen dì yī pī dǎsuàn xiān dìng yī qiān zhī, kànkàn shìchǎng fǎnyìng.
dialogue.en: For the first batch, we plan to order a thousand units to see the market response.

dialogue.speaker: Sales
dialogue.zh: 一千支的話，我們可以給您九五折的優惠。
dialogue.pinyin: Yī qiān zhī de huà, wǒmen kěyǐ gěi nín jiǔ wǔ zhé de yōuhuì.
dialogue.en: For a thousand units, we can give you a 5% discount.

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.zh: 九五折不夠，如果我們訂兩千支，可以打九折嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Jiǔ wǔ zhé bùgòu, rúguǒ wǒmen dìng liǎng qiān zhī, kěyǐ dǎ jiǔ zhé ma?
dialogue.en: 5% is not enough. If we order two thousand units, can you give a 10% discount?

dialogue.speaker: Sales
dialogue.zh: 這...我需要請示一下我的主管，因為這個價格比較低。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè... wǒ xūyào qǐngshì yīxià wǒ de zhǔguǎn, yīnwèi zhège jiàgé bǐjiào dī.
dialogue.en: This... I need to ask my supervisor for instructions, because this price is relatively low.

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，請盡快回覆我。另外，交貨期大概需要多久？
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, qǐng jǐnkuài huífù wǒ. Lìngwài, jiāohuòqī dàgài xūyào duōjiǔ?
dialogue.en: No problem, please reply to me as soon as possible. Also, how long is the lead time?

dialogue.speaker: Sales
dialogue.zh: 如果今天確認訂單，大約兩個禮拜可以出貨。
dialogue.pinyin: Rúguǒ jīntiān quèrèn dìngdān, dàyuē liǎng gè lǐbài kěyǐ chūhuò.
dialogue.en: If the order is confirmed today, it can be shipped in about two weeks.

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.zh: 兩個禮拜可以接受。那就等你的報價了。
dialogue.pinyin: Liǎng gè lǐbài kěyǐ jiēshòu. Nà jiù děng nǐ de bàojià le.
dialogue.en: Two weeks is acceptable. Then I will wait for your quote.

dialogue.speaker: Sales
dialogue.zh: 好的，我最晚明天早上給您正式的回覆。謝謝您的支持！
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ zuì wǎn míngtiān zǎoshàng gěi nín zhèngshì de huífù. Xièxiè nín de zhīchí!
dialogue.en: Okay, I will give you a formal reply by tomorrow morning at the latest. Thank you for your support!

listening.text: 非常感謝您一直以來對本公司的支持。由於近期原物料價格上漲，我們不得不在下個月微調部分產品的價格。造成您的不便，敬請見諒。

questions.q: What is the company expressing to the customer?
What is the reason for the upcoming change?
What change is going to happen next month?
What does '微調' mean?
How does the company feel about the inconvenience?
options: They apologize and ask for understanding
questions.answer: They apologize and ask for understanding

reading.text: 維護客戶關係是業務員最重要的工作。逢年過節時，寄送賀卡或小禮物能讓客戶感受到我們的誠意。當客戶提出客訴時，我們必須耐心傾聽，並迅速提出解決方案。只有建立互信的基礎，才能有長久的合作。

What should be done during holidays?
