title: Chapter 17: University Life
subtitle: Work & Study
entry_description: Talk about university clubs, exams, and academic life.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 你今年有打算參加什麼社團嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ jīnnián yǒu dǎsuàn cānjiā shénme shètuán ma?
dialogue.en: Do you plan to join any clubs this year?

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 我想參加登山社或是熱舞社，可是我怕沒有時間。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cānjiā dēngshānshè huòshì rèwǔshè, kěshì wǒ pà méiyǒu shíjiān.
dialogue.en: I want to join the hiking club or the dance club, but I'm afraid I won't have time.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 大學生活就是要豐富一點嘛！而且參加社團可以認識很多不同系的人。
dialogue.pinyin: Dàxué shēnghuó jiùshì yào fēngfù yīdiǎn ma! Érqiě cānjiā shètuán kěyǐ rènshì hěnduō bùtóng xì de rén.
dialogue.en: University life should be enriching! Plus, joining clubs lets you meet people from different departments.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。那你參加了什麼？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì. Nà nǐ cānjiā le shénme?
dialogue.en: You're right. What did you join?

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 我加入了吉他社，我們下個月還有迎新表演呢。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ jiārù le jítāshè, wǒmen xià gè yuè hái yǒu yíngxīn biǎoyǎn ne.
dialogue.en: I joined the guitar club; we even have a welcome performance next month.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 哇，太酷了！到時候我一定去幫你加油。
dialogue.pinyin: Wa, tài kù le! Dàoshíhòu wǒ yīdìng qù bāng nǐ jiāyóu.
dialogue.en: Wow, that's cool! I'll definitely go cheer for you then.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 一言為定！如果你選了登山社，記得帶我去爬山。
dialogue.pinyin: Yīyán wéidìng! Rúguǒ nǐ xuǎn le dēngshānshè, jìde dài wǒ qù páshān.
dialogue.en: It's a promise! If you choose the hiking club, remember to take me hiking.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。聽說登山社這個週末要去爬百岳。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Tīngshuō dēngshānshè zhège zhōumò yào qù pá Bǎiyuè.
dialogue.en: No problem. I heard the hiking club is going to climb the Baiyue (100 Peaks) this weekend.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很挑戰體力。你要做好準備喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái hěn tiǎozhàn tǐlì. Nǐ yào zuò hǎo zhǔnbèi ō.
dialogue.en: Sounds very physically challenging. You need to be well prepared.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 我今晚就會去買新的登山鞋和裝備。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ jīnwǎn jiù huì qù mǎi xīn de dēngshān xié hé zhuāngbèi.
dialogue.en: I'll go buy new hiking shoes and equipment tonight.

listening.text: 歡迎各位新生來到這所大學。今天下午一點在體育館有社團博覽會。現場有超過一百個社團的攤位，大家可以去看看有沒有自己感興趣的活動。

questions.q: Who is the speaker welcoming?
What event is taking place at 1 PM?
Where is the event located?
How many clubs are roughly participating?
What are students encouraged to do?
options: Look for activities they are interested in
questions.answer: Look for activities they are interested in

reading.text: 在台灣的大學裡，「迎新」是非常重要的傳統活動。學長姐會舉辦迎新露營或是晚會，幫助新生更快融入校園生活。此外，「直屬」制度也很常見，高年級的學生會特別照顧低年級的學弟妹，傳授選課經驗或是送他們二手的教科書。

questions.q: What is an important traditional activity in Taiwan's universities?
What is the purpose of the orientation camp?
options: To help freshmen integrate into campus life faster
questions.answer: To help freshmen integrate into campus life faster

questions.q: What is the '直屬' (direct junior/senior) system?
options: Senior students taking care of junior students
questions.answer: Senior students taking care of junior students

questions.q: What is one thing senior students might do for their juniors?
What physical item might seniors give to juniors?

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 期中考快到了，你準備得怎麼樣？
dialogue.pinyin: Qīzhōngkǎo kuài dào le, nǐ zhǔnbèi de zěnmeyàng?
dialogue.en: Midterms are coming up, how is your preparation?

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 別提了，我還有兩篇期中報告沒寫完，快崩潰了。
dialogue.pinyin: Bié tí le, wǒ hái yǒu liǎng piān qīzhōng bàogào méi xiě wán, kuài bēngkuì le.
dialogue.en: Don't bring it up, I still have two midterm papers unfinished, I'm about to break down.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 你需要幫忙嗎？我可以借你我的筆記。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ xūyào bāngmáng ma? Wǒ kěyǐ jiè nǐ wǒ de bǐjì.
dialogue.en: Do you need help? I can lend you my notes.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 太感謝了！你的經濟學筆記借我看一下，我有一章完全聽不懂。
dialogue.pinyin: Tài gǎnxiè le! Nǐ de jīngjìxué bǐjì jiè wǒ kàn yīxià, wǒ yǒu yī zhāng wánquán tīng bù dǒng.
dialogue.en: Thank you so much! Lend me your Economics notes to look at, there's one chapter I completely didn't understand.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，明天上課我帶給你。你要不要跟我去圖書館熬夜？
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, míngtiān shàngkè wǒ dài gěi nǐ. Nǐ yào bùyào gēn wǒ qù túshūguǎn áoyè?
dialogue.en: No problem, I'll bring them to class tomorrow. Do you want to go to the library with me to pull an all-nighter?

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 圖書館現在一定客滿了，根本找不到位子。
dialogue.pinyin: Túshūguǎn xiànzài yīdìng kèmǎn le, gēnběn zhǎo bù dào wèizi.
dialogue.en: The library must be completely full now, it's impossible to find a seat.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 那我們去學校旁邊那家二十四小時的咖啡廳吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà wǒmen qù xuéxiào pángbiān nà jiā èrshísì xiǎoshí de kāfēitīng ba.
dialogue.en: Then let's go to that 24-hour cafe next to the school.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 好主意，有咖啡提神，我應該可以把報告寫完。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo zhǔyì, yǒu kāfēi tíshén, wǒ yīnggāi kěyǐ bǎ bàogào xiě wán.
dialogue.en: Good idea, with coffee to refresh me, I should be able to finish the papers.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 那就這麼說定了，晚上九點在咖啡廳門口見。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà jiù zhème shuō dìng le, wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn zài kāfēitīng ménkǒu jiàn.
dialogue.en: Then it's settled, see you at the cafe entrance at 9 PM.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 好，不見不散。謝謝你陪我一起奮戰。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, bùjiàn bùsàn. Xièxiè nǐ péi wǒ yīqǐ fènzhàn.
dialogue.en: Okay, see you there. Thanks for fighting alongside me.

listening.text: 這門課的評分標準是：平時出席率佔百分之二十，期中考百分之三十，期末報告百分之五十。請大家務必在期限內上傳報告，遲交一天扣五分。

reading.text: 到了期中或期末考週，大學圖書館通常會人滿為患。有些學生甚至會提早去排隊「佔位子」。為了準備考試，許多學生會熬夜苦讀，咖啡和提神飲料成了他們的好夥伴。考完試後，大家通常會去吃頓大餐或是唱歌，好好放鬆一下。

title: Chapter 18: Health & Hobbies
subtitle: Social & Hobbies
entry_description: Discuss physical health, sports, and recreational activities.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 你最近看起來精神很好，有在運動嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn kàn qǐlái jīngshén hěn hǎo, yǒu zài yùndòng ma?
dialogue.en: You look very energetic lately, have you been exercising?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 對啊，我上個月報名了家裡附近的健身房。每週去三次。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì a, wǒ shàng gè yuè bàomíng le jiālǐ fùjìn de jiànshēnfáng. Měi zhōu qù sān cì.
dialogue.en: Yeah, I signed up for a gym near my house last month. I go three times a week.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 真有毅力。你都在健身房做什麼運動？
dialogue.pinyin: Zhēn yǒu yìlì. Nǐ dōu zài jiànshēnfáng zuò shénme yùndòng?
dialogue.en: That's real perseverance. What exercises do you do at the gym?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 我通常先在跑步機上跑三十分鐘當作熱身，然後做重訓。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ tōngcháng xiān zài pǎobùjī shàng pǎo sānshí fēnzhōng dāngzuò rèshēn, ránhòu zuò zhòngxùn.
dialogue.en: I usually run on the treadmill for 30 minutes as a warm-up, then do weight training.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 重訓會不會很容易受傷？
dialogue.pinyin: Zhòngxùn huì bù huì hěn róngyì shòushāng?
dialogue.en: Is weight training easy to get injured doing?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 如果姿勢不正確的確會。所以我請了一個私人教練指導我。
dialogue.pinyin: Rúguǒ zīshì bù zhèngquè díquè huì. Suǒyǐ wǒ qǐng le yīgè sīrén jiàoliàn zhǐdǎo wǒ.
dialogue.en: If the posture is incorrect, indeed. So I hired a personal trainer to guide me.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 教練費應該不便宜吧？
dialogue.pinyin: Jiàoliànfèi yīnggāi bù piányí ba?
dialogue.en: Trainer fees probably aren't cheap, right?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 是有點貴，但為了健康和安全，我覺得很值得。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì yǒudiǎn guì, dàn wèile jiànkāng hé ānquán, wǒ juédé hěn zhídé.
dialogue.en: It is a bit expensive, but for health and safety, I think it's worth it.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 聽你這樣說，我也想去運動了。我最近一直坐在辦公室，肚子都出來了。
dialogue.pinyin: Tīng nǐ zhèyàng shuō, wǒ yě xiǎng qù yùndòng le. Wǒ zuìjìn yīzhí zuò zài bàngōngshì, dùzi dōu chūlái le.
dialogue.en: Hearing you say this, I want to go exercise too. I've been sitting in the office lately, and my belly is showing.

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 那下次我們一起去吧！我們可以互相督促。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà xià cì wǒmen yīqǐ qù ba! Wǒmen kěyǐ hùxiāng dūcù.
dialogue.en: Then let's go together next time! We can urge each other on.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.zh: 醫生，我這兩天覺得頭很痛，而且一直咳嗽。
dialogue.pinyin: Yīshēng, wǒ zhè liǎng tiān juédé tóu hěn tòng, érqiě yīzhí késòu.
dialogue.en: Doctor, for the past two days my head hurts a lot, and I keep coughing.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 你有發燒嗎？讓我幫你量一下體溫。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu fāshāo ma? Ràng wǒ bāng nǐ liáng yīxià tǐwēn.
dialogue.en: Do you have a fever? Let me measure your temperature.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.zh: 昨天晚上好像有一點發燒，但今天早上好多了。
dialogue.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng hǎoxiàng yǒu yīdiǎn fāshāo, dàn jīntiān zǎoshàng hǎo duō le.
dialogue.en: It seemed I had a slight fever last night, but it's much better this morning.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 三十七度半，還有點微燒。你的喉嚨也會痛嗎？請張開嘴巴說「啊」。
dialogue.pinyin: Sānshíqī dù bàn, hái yǒudiǎn wéishāo. Nǐ de hóulóng yě huì tòng ma? Qǐng zhāngkāi zuǐbā shuō 'a'.
dialogue.en: 37.5 degrees, still a slight fever. Does your throat hurt too? Please open your mouth and say 'ah'.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.zh: 啊—— 吞東西的時候喉嚨有點痛。
dialogue.pinyin: A—— Tūn dōngxī de shíhòu hóulóng yǒudiǎn tòng.
dialogue.en: Ah—— My throat hurts a bit when I swallow things.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 你的扁桃腺有點發炎。這應該是流行性感冒。我開一些藥給你。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ de biǎntáoxiàn yǒudiǎn fāyán. Zhè yīnggāi shì liúxíng xìng gǎnmào. Wǒ kāi yīxiē yào gěi nǐ.
dialogue.en: Your tonsils are a bit inflamed. This should be the flu. I will prescribe some medicine for you.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.zh: 這些藥要怎麼吃？
dialogue.pinyin: Zhèxiē yào yào zěnme chī?
dialogue.en: How should I take these medicines?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 一天吃三次，飯後吃。這幾天要多喝溫水，多休息，不要吃太辣的食物。
dialogue.pinyin: Yī tiān chī sān cì, fànhòu chī. Zhè jǐ tiān yào duō hē wēnshuǐ, duō xiūxí, bùyào chī tài là de shíwù.
dialogue.en: Take them three times a day, after meals. Drink lots of warm water these few days, get plenty of rest, and don't eat food that's too spicy.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.zh: 好的，醫生。我需要請假在家休息嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, yīshēng. Wǒ xūyào qǐngjià zài jiā xiūxí ma?
dialogue.en: Okay, doctor. Do I need to take time off to rest at home?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 最好請假一兩天，避免傳染給同事。我幫你開一張診斷證明。
dialogue.pinyin: Zuì hǎo qǐngjià yī liǎng tiān, bìmiǎn chuánrǎn gěi tóngshì. Wǒ bāng nǐ kāi yī zhāng zhěnduàn zhèngmíng.
dialogue.en: It's best to take a day or two off to avoid infecting colleagues. I will write a medical certificate for you.

listening.text: 林大明先生，請到第三診間就診。看診後請拿著處方箋到外面的藥局領藥。謝謝您的配合。

reading.text: 台灣的「全民健康保險」（簡稱健保）非常有名。只要你有健保卡，去診所看病通常只需要付大約一百五十到兩百元台幣的掛號費，剩下的費用會由健保幫你支付。這讓民眾能以很低的成本獲得高品質的醫療服務。因此，外國人在台灣工作或留學，通常都會強制加入健保。

title: Chapter 19: Social Life & Dating
subtitle: Social & Hobbies
entry_description: Navigate social situations, making plans, and dating.

dialogue.speaker: Male
dialogue.zh: 嘿，你這週末有空嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hēi, nǐ zhè zhōumò yǒu kòng ma?
dialogue.en: Hey, are you free this weekend?

dialogue.speaker: Female
dialogue.zh: 這週末？我禮拜六下午要去上瑜伽課，禮拜天目前沒有計畫。怎麼了？
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè zhōumò? Wǒ lǐbài liù xiàwǔ yào qù shàng yújiākè, lǐbài tiān mùqián méiyǒu jìhuà. Zěnme le?
dialogue.en: This weekend? I'm going to a yoga class on Saturday afternoon; no plans for Sunday yet. What's up?

dialogue.speaker: Male
dialogue.zh: 聽說最近有一部新上映的科幻電影評價很好，想問你要不要一起去看？
dialogue.pinyin: Tīngshuō zuìjìn yǒu yī bù xīn shàngyìng de kēhuàn diànyǐng píngjià hěn hǎo, xiǎng wèn nǐ yào bùyào yīqǐ qù kàn?
dialogue.en: I heard a newly released sci-fi movie has great reviews recently, I wanted to ask if you'd like to go see it together?

dialogue.speaker: Female
dialogue.zh: 你是說那部關於時間旅行的電影嗎？我也很想看！
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ shì shuō nà bù guānyú shíjiān lǚxíng de diànyǐng ma? Wǒ yě hěn xiǎng kàn!
dialogue.en: Are you talking about that movie about time travel? I really want to see it too!

dialogue.speaker: Male
dialogue.zh: 對，就是那部。那我們禮拜天下午去看，好嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, jiùshì nà bù. Nà wǒmen lǐbài tiān xiàwǔ qù kàn, hǎo ma?
dialogue.en: Yes, that's the one. Then let's go see it on Sunday afternoon, okay?

dialogue.speaker: Female
dialogue.zh: 好啊。我們在哪間電影院看？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a. Wǒmen zài nǎ jiān diànyǐngyuàn kàn?
dialogue.en: Sure. Which cinema are we seeing it at?

dialogue.speaker: Male
dialogue.zh: 去信義區那家吧，看完電影我們還可以去附近的餐酒館吃晚餐。
dialogue.pinyin: Qù Xìnyì qū nà jiā ba, kàn wán diànyǐng wǒmen hái kěyǐ qù fùjìn de cānjiǔguǎn chī wǎncān.
dialogue.en: Let's go to the one in Xinyi District. After the movie, we can also go to a nearby bistro for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: Female
dialogue.zh: 聽起來是個很棒的計畫。那是幾點的場次？
dialogue.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái shìgè hěn bàng de jìhuà. Nà shì jǐ diǎn de chǎngcì?
dialogue.en: Sounds like a great plan. What time is the showing?

dialogue.speaker: Male
dialogue.zh: 我晚點上網查一下時間再跟你確認。我會先把票訂好。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ wǎndiǎn shàngwǎng chá yīxià shíjiān zài gēn nǐ quèrèn. Wǒ huì xiān bǎ piào dìng hǎo.
dialogue.en: I'll check the times online later and confirm with you. I'll book the tickets first.

dialogue.speaker: Female
dialogue.zh: 那就麻煩你了，期待禮拜天的約會！
dialogue.pinyin: Nà jiù máfan nǐ le, qīdài lǐbài tiān de yuēhuì!
dialogue.en: Then I'll trouble you with that. Looking forward to our date on Sunday!

listening.text: 為了給她一個驚喜，我偷偷訂了那家很難訂位的米其林餐廳。我還準備了一束紅玫瑰，希望今晚的週年紀念日約會能非常完美。

dialogue.speaker: Guest A
dialogue.zh: 哇，今天來了好多人啊！這個派對真熱鬧。
dialogue.pinyin: Wa, jīntiān lái le hǎoduō rén a! Zhège pàiduì zhēn rènào.
dialogue.en: Wow, so many people came today! This party is really lively.

dialogue.speaker: Guest B
dialogue.zh: 是啊，這是John的生日派對，他邀請了所有的好朋友。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì a, zhè shì John de shēngrì pàiduì, tā yāoqǐng le suǒyǒu de hǎo péngyǒu.
dialogue.en: Yeah, it's John's birthday party, he invited all his good friends.

dialogue.speaker: Guest A
dialogue.zh: 我好像不認識那邊那個穿藍色洋裝的女生，你知道她也是John的同事嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoxiàng bù rènshì nàbiān nàge chuān lánsè yángzhuāng de nǚshēng, nǐ zhīdào tā yěshì John de tóngshì ma?
dialogue.en: I don't think I know that girl in the blue dress over there, do you know if she's also John's colleague?

dialogue.speaker: Guest B
dialogue.zh: 哦，她是John的表妹，剛從國外讀書回來。走，我帶你去認識她。
dialogue.pinyin: Ó, tā shì John de biǎomèi, gāng cóng guówài dúshū huílái. Zǒu, wǒ dài nǐ qù rènshì tā.
dialogue.en: Oh, she is John's cousin, just came back from studying abroad. Come on, I'll take you to meet her.

dialogue.speaker: Guest A
dialogue.zh: 好啊。我們需要先拿點飲料嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a. Wǒmen xūyào xiān ná diǎn yǐnliào ma?
dialogue.en: Sure. Do we need to grab some drinks first?

dialogue.speaker: Guest B
dialogue.zh: 餐桌那裡有紅酒和香檳，你想喝什麼？
dialogue.pinyin: Cānzhuō nàlǐ yǒu hóngjiǔ hé xiāngbīn, nǐ xiǎng hē shénme?
dialogue.en: There's red wine and champagne at the dining table, what do you want to drink?

dialogue.speaker: Guest A
dialogue.zh: 給我一杯香檳吧，今天有慶祝的氣氛。
dialogue.pinyin: Gěi wǒ yī bēi xiāngbīn ba, jīntiān yǒu qìngzhù de qìfēn.
dialogue.en: Give me a glass of champagne, there's a celebratory atmosphere today.

dialogue.speaker: Guest B
dialogue.zh: （走向表妹）嗨，Lisa。介紹一下，這位是我的好朋友，Kevin。
dialogue.pinyin: (Zǒuxiàng biǎomèi) Hāi, Lisa. Jièshào yīxià, zhè wèi shì wǒ de hǎo péngyǒu, Kevin.
dialogue.en: (Walking to the cousin) Hi, Lisa. Let me introduce you, this is my good friend, Kevin.

dialogue.speaker: Lisa
dialogue.zh: 你好，Kevin。常聽John提起你，很高興終於見面了。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, Kevin. Cháng tīng John tíqǐ nǐ, hěn gāoxìng zhōngyú jiànmiàn le.
dialogue.en: Hello, Kevin. I often hear John mention you, so glad to finally meet.

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.zh: 我也很高興認識你。聽說你剛回國，覺得台灣的天氣還習慣嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng rènshì nǐ. Tīngshuō nǐ gāng huíguó, juédé Táiwān de tiānqì hái xíguàn ma?
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you too. I heard you just came back to the country; are you used to Taiwan's weather yet?

listening.text: 大家安靜一下！讓我們舉起手中的酒杯，祝我們的壽星生日快樂！希望他在新的一年裡，身體健康，事業順利！乾杯！

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.zh: 你有看今天早上的新聞嗎？關於全球氣候暖化的那篇報導。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu kàn jīntiān zǎoshàng de xīnwén ma? Guānyú quánqiú qìhòu nuǎnhuà de nà piān bàodǎo.
dialogue.en: Did you watch the news this morning? That report about global warming.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.zh: 有啊，情況似乎比想像中還要嚴重。極端天氣越來越頻繁了。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu a, qíngkuàng sìhū bǐ xiǎngxiàng zhōng hái yào yánzhòng. Jíduān tiānqì yuè lái yuè pínfán le.
dialogue.en: Yes, the situation seems even more serious than imagined. Extreme weather is becoming more and more frequent.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。我覺得政府應該制定更嚴格的環保法規，限制工業廢氣排放。
dialogue.pinyin: Méicuò. Wǒ juédé zhèngfǔ yīnggāi zhìdìng gèng yángé de huánbǎo fǎguī, xiànzhì gōngyè fèiqì páifàng.
dialogue.en: Exactly. I think the government should enact stricter environmental regulations to limit industrial emissions.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.zh: 我同意，但這也會影響到經濟發展。這是一個很難取得平衡的問題。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ tóngyì, dàn zhè yě huì yǐngxiǎng dào jīngjì fāzhǎn. Zhè shì yīgè hěn nán qǔdé pínghéng de wèntí.
dialogue.en: I agree, but this will also affect economic development. It's a problem that's hard to balance.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.zh: 的確，不過身為一般市民，我們也可以從日常生活中做起，比如說減少使用塑膠產品。
dialogue.pinyin: Díquè, bùguò shēnwéi yībān shìmín, wǒmen yě kěyǐ cóng rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng zuò qǐ, bǐrú shuō jiǎnshǎo shǐyòng sùjiāo chǎnpǐn.
dialogue.en: Indeed, but as ordinary citizens, we can also start from daily life, for example, reducing the use of plastic products.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.zh: 對，我現在出門都會自己帶環保杯和購物袋。積少成多嘛。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, wǒ xiànzài chūmén dōu huì zìjǐ dài huánbǎobēi hé gòuwùdài. Jī shǎo chéng duō ma.
dialogue.en: Right, now when I go out I always bring my own reusable cup and shopping bag. Many a little makes a mickle.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.zh: 還有搭乘大眾運輸工具。其實台灣的捷運和公車已經非常方便了。
dialogue.pinyin: Hái yǒu dāchéng dàzhòng yùnshū gōngjù. Qíshí Táiwān de jiéyùn hé gōngchē yǐjīng fēicháng fāngbiàn le.
dialogue.en: And also taking public transportation. Actually, Taiwan's MRT and buses are already very convenient.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.zh: 是啊。希望透過大家的努力，能減緩地球暖化的速度。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì a. Xīwàng tòuguò dàjiā de nǔlì, néng jiǎnhuǎn dìqiú nuǎnhuà de sùdù.
dialogue.en: Yes. I hope through everyone's efforts, we can slow down the speed of global warming.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.zh: 對了，這週末社區有舉辦淨灘活動，你要不要一起去參加？
dialogue.pinyin: Duì le, zhè zhōumò shèqū yǒu jǔbàn jìngtān huódòng, nǐ yào bùyào yīqǐ qù cānjiā?
dialogue.en: By the way, the community is holding a beach cleanup activity this weekend, do you want to join together?

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.zh: 好啊，非常有意義的活動。算我一份！
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a, fēicháng yǒu yìyì de huódòng. Suàn wǒ yī fèn!
dialogue.en: Sure, a very meaningful activity. Count me in!

listening.text: 近年來，人工智慧（AI）的發展非常迅速，許多傳統的工作正面臨被取代的危機。然而，專家指出，AI雖然能處理重複性的任務，但無法完全取代人類的創造力與同理心。因此，我們應該學習如何與AI協作，而不是害怕它。

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 時間過得真快，我們快要畢業了。你畢業後有什麼打算？
dialogue.pinyin: Shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài, wǒmen kuài yào bìyè le. Nǐ bìyè hòu yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?
dialogue.en: Time flies so fast, we are about to graduate. What are your plans after graduation?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 我打算先休息一個月，然後去歐洲當背包客，體驗一下不同的文化。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn xiān xiūxí yīgè yuè, ránhòu qù Ōuzhōu dāng bēibāokè, tǐyàn yīxià bùtóng de wénhuà.
dialogue.en: I plan to rest for a month first, and then go backpacking in Europe to experience different cultures.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 好羨慕你啊！那你旅行回來之後呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo xiànmù nǐ a! Nà nǐ lǚxíng huílái zhīhòu ne?
dialogue.en: I envy you so much! What about after you come back from traveling?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 我想申請外商公司的儲備幹部計畫。我的目標是五年內當上專案經理。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shēnqǐng wàishāng gōngsī de chǔbèi gànbù jìhuà. Wǒ de mùbiāo shì wǔ nián nèi dāng shàng zhuā'àn jīnglǐ.
dialogue.en: I want to apply for a management associate program at a foreign company. My goal is to become a project manager within five years.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 你一直都很有野心。我相信你一定能做到的！
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yīzhí dōu hěn yǒu yěxīn. Wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ yīdìng néng zuò dào de!
dialogue.en: You have always been very ambitious. I believe you will definitely be able to do it!

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的鼓勵。那你呢？你要繼續讀研究所嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè nǐ de gǔlì. Nà nǐ ne? Nǐ yào jìxù dú yánjiūsuǒ ma?
dialogue.en: Thanks for your encouragement. What about you? Are you going to continue to graduate school?

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 對，我已經考上台大的資訊工程研究所了。我對人工智慧的研究很有興趣。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, wǒ yǐjīng kǎo shàng Tái Dà de zīxùn gōngchéng yánjiūsuǒ le. Wǒ duì réngōng zhìhuì de yánjiū hěn yǒu xìngqù.
dialogue.en: Yes, I've already been accepted into the Computer Science graduate program at NTU. I am very interested in AI research.

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 哇，恭喜你！這是現在最熱門的領域。未來的發展一定無可限量。
dialogue.pinyin: Wa, gōngxǐ nǐ! Zhè shì xiànzài zuì rèmén de lǐngyù. Wèilái de fāzhǎn yīdìng wúkě xiànliàng.
dialogue.en: Wow, congratulations! That's the hottest field right now. Future developments will definitely be limitless.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 希望如此。不管我們未來在哪裡，都要保持聯絡喔！
dialogue.pinyin: Xīwàng rúcǐ. Bùguǎn wǒmen wèilái zài nǎlǐ, dōu yào bǎochí liánluò ō!
dialogue.en: I hope so. No matter where we are in the future, we must keep in touch!

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 那是一定的！祝我們都有光明的前程！
dialogue.pinyin: Nà shì yīdìng de! Zhù wǒmen dōu yǒu guāngmíng de qiánchéng!
dialogue.en: That is for sure! Wishing us both a bright future!

reading.text: 在華人文化中，「立業成家」是一個傳統的觀念，意味著人應該先建立穩定的事業，然後再考慮結婚生子。然而，隨著時代的變遷，現代年輕人的價值觀已經大不相同。許多人更重視「自我實現」和生活品質，不一定把結婚買房當作人生的唯一目標。有的人選擇成為自由工作者（Freelancer），有的人選擇到世界各地旅居。每個人都在用自己的方式，定義屬於自己的成功。
